descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Index Analyst

Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8229

Do you want to work in a dynamic environment at the heart of financial markets? Are you passionate about data quality, operational excellence, and collaboration? Curious about how indices such as the IBEX 35, SMI and SPI are maintained every day?

Then our Index Operations team wants to hear from you! We are an agile and international team responsible for the daily maintenance, reviews, and quality assurance of SIX’s equity and fixed income indices. By ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and integrity of indices used as benchmarks for financial products worldwide, we play a key role in supporting global financial markets. In this role, you will work closely with Product Management, IT, Index Sales, and clients in a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English. We are looking forward to hear from you!

What You Will Do

• Responsible for the management and maintenance of all SIX and custom equity and fixed income indices, with a primary focus on SIX Spanish indices.

• Participate in Production, Corporate Actions, and Index Review shift rotations, including the coordination of ongoing index changes.

• Determine index constituents and weightings as part of the periodic review process.

• Provide incident management support and 2nd level operational support.

• Implement index changes across relevant applications and systems.

• Ensure compliance with Working Instructions, Index Governance requirements, and the Controls Framework.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of operational quality, process stability, and efficiency, including the execution of Business Acceptance Testing (BAT).

What You Bring

• Bachelor's degree in Economics, Business Administration or any related field. Studies related with the financial sector or Capital Markets will be a plus.

• 1st working experience in the financial sector, preferable in operational, middle-office or back-office areas.

• Ability to perform under pressure, manage priorities effectively and able to work independently with a well-organized and self-driven personality.

• Strong organizational and prioritization skills.

• Excellent Spanish and English communication skills; German will be an advantage.

• Strong Excel and Python skills for data analysis, automation, and operational support.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Senior IT Risk and Control Officer

Varsavia | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8061

Sei appassionato di finanza e tecnologia moderna? Hai buone capacità organizzative? Se sì, questo è il posto giusto per te.

Coordinate il rischio IT e controllate da un team centrale distribuito tra Svizzera, Spagna e Polonia, per garantire un'adeguata metodologia di rischio e valutazione e la bonifica in tempo di carenza. Aiuta anche le PMI operative a valutare i loro rischi e processi di controllo interno. Insieme con il team diversificato e motivato si aiuta a semplificare e ottimizzare il paesaggio GRC, sviluppare modelli e linee guida e formare l'organizzazione verso l'ambiente regolamentato e la necessità di controlli GRC.

Cosa farai

• Responsabile della corretta identificazione, revisione e gestione del rischio insieme alle PMI operative

• Assicurare agli stakeholder un report appropriato sull'universo di rischio e controllo insieme a LoD2

• Sviluppare attivamente il paesaggio degli strumenti GRC e aiutare a automatizzare e aumentare la maturità

• Gestire e migliorare il catalogo di controllo ICS (Internal Control System) e i suoi test, garantendo completezza, precisione e allineamento con i requisiti normativi

• Agire come unico punto di contatto per gli argomenti IT GRC e assumere un ruolo di coordinatore e interfaccia, compresa la formazione e la consapevolezza per le iniziative di gestione delle linee, PMI, progetti e GRC

Che cosa porta

• Diversi anni di esperienza in IT Risk & Control, Audit e Operazioni

• Conoscenza interdisciplinare dei processi, delle operazioni e delle architetture IT

• Esperienza dimostrata nelle strategie di identificazione, valutazione e mitigazione dei rischi IT

• Comprensione e applicazione delle metodologie IT di rischio, audit e controllo

• Buone capacità organizzative, modo strutturato di lavorare e la capacità di identificare i problemi e risolverli sistematicamente

• Molto buono scritto e parlato inglese competenze. Il tedesco e/o lo spagnolo sono un vantaggio.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Mateusz Kozielec al numero +41583998611 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior IT Risk and Control Officer

Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8061

Are you passionate about finance and modern technology? Do you have good organizational skills? If yes, this is the right place for you.

You coordinate the IT Risk and controls out of a central team distributed between Switzerland, Spain and Poland, to ensure appropriate risk methodology and assessment and in-time remediation of deficiencies. You also help the operational SMEs to assess their Risks and Internal Control processes. Together with the diverse and motivated team you help to simplify and optimize the GRC landscape, develop templates and guidance as well as train and educate the organization towards the regulated environment and the need of GRC controls.

What You Will Do

• Responsible for the proper risk identification, review and management together with operational SMEs

• Assure stakeholder appropriate reporting on the risk and control universe together with LoD2

• Actively develop the GRC tool landscape and help to automate and raise the maturity

• Manage and improve the ICS (Internal Control System) control catalogue and its testing, ensuring completeness, accuracy and alignment with regulatory requirements

• Act as the single point of contact for IT GRC topics and take a coordinator and interface role including training and awareness for line management, SME, projects and GRC initiatives

What You Bring

• Several years of experience in IT Risk & Control, Audit and Operations

• Interdisciplinary knowledge of IT processes, operations and architectures

• Proven experience in IT risk identification, assessment and mitigation strategies

• Understanding and applying IT risk, audit and control methodologies

• Good organizational skills, structured way of working and the ability to identify problems and solve them systematically

• Very good written and spoken English skills. German and/or Spanish are a plus.

•

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
descriptionByLocale.de:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Senior IT Risk and Control Officer

Warschau | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% | Referenz 8061

Sie interessieren sich für Finanzen und moderne Technologie? Haben Sie gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten? Wenn ja, ist dies der richtige Ort für Sie.

Sie koordinieren das IT-Risiko und die Steuerung aus einem zentralen Team, das zwischen der Schweiz, Spanien und Polen verteilt ist, um eine angemessene Risikomethodik und -bewertung sowie eine rechtzeitige Behebung von Mängeln sicherzustellen. Sie unterstützen auch die operativen KMU bei der Bewertung ihrer Risiken und internen Kontrollprozesse. Gemeinsam mit dem vielfältigen und motivierten Team helfen Sie, die GRC-Landschaft zu vereinfachen und zu optimieren, Vorlagen und Anleitungen zu entwickeln sowie die Organisation für das regulierte Umfeld und die Notwendigkeit von GRC-Kontrollen zu schulen und zu schulen.

Was Sie tun werden

• Verantwortlich für die richtige Risikoidentifizierung, -überprüfung und -management zusammen mit operativen KMU

• Sicherstellung einer angemessenen Berichterstattung der Stakeholder über das Risiko- und Kontrolluniversum zusammen mit LoD2

• Aktive Entwicklung der GRC-Tool-Landschaft und Hilfe bei der Automatisierung und Erhöhung der Reife

• Verwalten und verbessern Sie den Kontrollkatalog des ICS (Internal Control System) und dessen Tests, um Vollständigkeit, Genauigkeit und Übereinstimmung mit den regulatorischen Anforderungen zu gewährleisten

• Handeln Sie als einzige Anlaufstelle für IT GRC-Themen und übernehmen Sie eine Koordinator- und Schnittstellenrolle, einschließlich Schulung und Bewusstsein für Linienmanagement, KMU, Projekte und GRC-Initiativen

Was du mitbringst

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in IT Risk & Control, Audit und Operations

• Interdisziplinäres Wissen über IT-Prozesse, Abläufe und Architekturen

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in IT-Risikoerkennung, -bewertung und -minderungsstrategien

• Verständnis und Anwendung von IT-Risiko-, Audit- und Kontrollmethoden

• Gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, Probleme zu erkennen und systematisch zu lösen

• Sehr gute schriftliche und gesprochene Englischkenntnisse. Deutsch und/oder Spanisch sind ein Plus.

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Mateusz Kozielec unter +41583998611 an.

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Agent principal des risques et du contrôle de la TI

Varsovie : travailler à partir de chez soi jusqu'à 40 % Référence 8061

Êtes-vous passionné par la finance et la technologie moderne? Avez-vous de bonnes compétences organisationnelles? Si oui, c'est le bon endroit pour vous.

Vous coordonnez le risque informatique et les contrôles à partir d'une équipe centrale distribuée entre la Suisse, l'Espagne et la Pologne, afin d'assurer une méthodologie de risque appropriée et une évaluation et une correction à temps des lacunes. Vous aidez également les PME opérationnelles à évaluer leurs processus de risque et de contrôle interne. En collaboration avec l'équipe diversifiée et motivée, vous aidez à simplifier et à optimiser le paysage du GRC, à élaborer des modèles et des conseils, ainsi qu'à former et éduquer l'organisation à l'égard de l'environnement réglementé et du besoin de contrôles du GRC.

Ce que vous ferez

• Responsable de l'identification, de l'examen et de la gestion des risques avec les PME opérationnelles

• Assure aux parties prenantes des rapports appropriés sur l'univers de risque et de contrôle ainsi que sur LoD2

• Développer activement le paysage des outils du GRC et aider à automatiser et à élever la maturité

• Gérer et améliorer le catalogue de contrôle ICS (Internal Control System) et ses tests, en assurant l'exhaustivité, l'exactitude et l'alignement avec les exigences réglementaires

• Agir en tant que point de contact unique pour les sujets du GRC en TI et jouer un rôle de coordinateur et d'interface, y compris la formation et la sensibilisation à la gestion de ligne, aux PME, aux projets et aux initiatives du GRC

Ce que vous apportez

• Plusieurs années d'expérience en gestion des risques, vérification et opérations de TI

• Connaissance interdisciplinaire des processus, des opérations et des architectures informatiques

• Expérience éprouvée en matière de détermination, d'évaluation et de stratégies d'atténuation des risques liés aux TI

• Comprendre et appliquer les méthodes de contrôle, d'audit et de risque informatique

• Bonnes compétences organisationnelles, mode de travail structuré et capacité à identifier les problèmes et à les résoudre systématiquement

• Très bonnes compétences en anglais écrit et parlé. L'allemand et/ou l'espagnol sont un plus.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Mateusz Kozielec au +4158399861 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

Agente di assistenza clienti

Varsavia | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 7872

In questo ruolo ibrido, si combina il supporto clienti pratico con la proprietà di automazione e AI-driven miglioramenti. Gestisci le richieste dei clienti, identifica le opportunità per ridurre il lavoro manuale e aiuta i team ad adottare nuovi agenti AI e soluzioni di automazione. Si agisce come un contributore chiave nel migliorare l'esperienza del cliente durante la guida di efficienza attraverso le operazioni di supporto.

Cosa farai

• Gestisci le richieste di assistenza clienti con accuratezza, professionalità e una mentalità da primo cliente, garantendo al tempo stesso una corretta categorizzazione e qualità dei dati.

• 2+ anni di esperienza nell'assistenza clienti, nelle operazioni di assistenza, nel miglioramento dei processi o in un ambiente simile.

• Una mentalità proattiva e self-driven con passione per l'innovazione, l'automazione e il miglioramento continuo.

SIX sta guidando la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci rende diversi ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo una miscela unica di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti intelligenti e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro dei mercati finanziari con noi.

(Junior) Product Manager Pagamenti

Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8199

Vuoi lavorare in un ambiente emozionante e contribuire a plasmare la digitalizzazione in Svizzera? Dopo la vostra formazione, avete già acquisito esperienza iniziale nel campo della gestione del prodotto o delle transazioni di pagamento? Lo sviluppo del prodotto e il suo impatto sul business sono la vostra passione? Sei interessato al futuro sviluppo delle transazioni di pagamento? Allora il nostro team di gestione dei prodotti vuole sentire da voi!

Siamo un team ambizioso e dinamico responsabile dello sviluppo di varie soluzioni per il centro finanziario svizzero. In qualità di responsabile del prodotto, fai parte della gestione del prodotto per la piattaforma di pagamento SIC e assicurati che i nostri sistemi siano disponibili per le banche in Svizzera in qualsiasi momento e trattino milioni di transazioni in modo efficiente ogni giorno. In un team interdisciplinare e in interazione con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni, vi aiuterà a garantire che la Svizzera abbia soluzioni leader a livello globale nel processo di pagamento e si sta sviluppando in modo graduale verso i pagamenti istantanei.

Questi sono i tuoi compiti

• Si sposta nella comunità bancaria, sviluppare soluzioni realizzabili con uffici interni o in gruppi di lavoro e trasmettere le proprie posizioni vividamente.

• Concezione di funzioni e sviluppo di soluzioni esistenti.

• Creazione di concetti di business per lo sviluppo strategico del prodotto.

• Supporto dei team IT nella fase di sviluppo e implementazione dei prodotti e delle estensioni dei prodotti nel ruolo del product manager.

• Sviluppo dei principi decisionali sullo sviluppo dei prodotti per i gruppi di lavoro

Lo porti con te.

• Forte capacità concettuale e piacere di comunicare soluzioni progettate e l'implementazione del drive.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e presentazione, nonché il talento di costruire il consenso sulle soluzioni.

• Buone competenze di gestione degli stakeholder per incoraggiare la collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.

• esperienza nelle soluzioni di pagamento digitale; Preferito come product manager sono vantaggiosi.

• Molto buona conoscenza di tedesco e inglese in parola e scrittura. La conoscenza del francese è un vantaggio.

descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX is driving the transformation of financial markets.

What makes us different drives us forward: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique mixture of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value smart minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of financial markets with us.

(Junior) Product Manager Payments

Zurich | Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8199

Do you want to work in an exciting environment and help shape digitalisation in Switzerland? After your training, have you already gained initial experience in the field of product management or payment transactions? Are product development and its impact on business results your passion? Are you interested in the future development of payment transactions? Then our product management team wants to hear from you!

We are an ambitious, dynamic team responsible for the development of various solutions for the Swiss financial centre. As a product manager, you are part of the product management for the payment platform SIC and ensure that our systems are available for banks in Switzerland at any time and process millions of transactions efficiently every day. In an interdisciplinary team and in interaction with internal and external stakeholders, you will help ensure that Switzerland has globally leading solutions in payment processing and is developing in step-by-step fashion towards instant payments.

These are your tasks

• You move in the banking community, develop viable solutions with internal offices or in working groups and convey your own positions vividly.

• Conception of functions and the further development of existing solutions.

• Creation of business concepts for strategic product development.

• Support of the IT teams in the development and implementation phase of products and product extensions in the role of product manager.

• Development of decision-making principles around product development for working groups

You bring that with you

• Strong conceptual ability and pleasure to communicate designed solutions and drive implementation.

• Strong communication and presentation skills as well as the talent to build consensus on solutions.

• Good stakeholder management skills to encourage collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

• experience in digital payment solutions; Preferred as a product manager are advantageous.

• Very good knowledge of German and English in word and writing. Knowledge of French is an advantage.

If you have any questions, visit our FAQ page or contact Mateusz Kozielec on +41583998611.

For this vacancy, we only consider direct applications.

Diversity is important to us, so we welcome applications regardless of personal background.

(Junior) Product Manager Payments

Zurich | Working from home up to 40% possible | Referenz 8199

Möchtest du in einem spannenden Umfeld arbeiten und die Digitalisierung in der Schweiz mitgestalten? Sind Produktentwicklung und deren Auswirkungen auf Geschäftsergebnisse deine Leidenschaft? Interessiert Dich die künftige Entwicklung des Zahlungsverkehrs? Dann möchte unser Product Management Team von dir hören!

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes, dynamisches Team, das für die Entwicklung verschiedener Lösungen für den Finanzplatz Schweiz verantwortlich ist. Als Produkt ManagerIn bist du Teil des Product Managements für die Zahlungsplattform SIC und stellst sicher, dass unsere Systeme für die Banken in der Schweiz jederzeit zur Verfügung stehen und jeden Tag Millionen von Transaktionen effizient abwickeln. In einem interdisziplinären Team und in Interaktion mit internen und externen Stakeholdern trägst du dazu bei, dass die Schweiz über global führende Lösungen in der Zahlungsabwicklung verfügt und sich zeitgemäss in grossen Schritten in Richtung «instant payments» entwickelt.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Du bewegst dich in der Bankencommunity, entwickelst mit internen Stellen oder in Arbeitsgruppen tragfähige Lösungen und vermittelst die eigene Positionen anschaulich.

• Konzeption von Funktionen sowie die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Lösungen.

• Erstellung von Business-Konzepten für die strategische Produktentwicklung.

• Begleitung der IT-Teams in der Entwicklungs- und Implementierungsphase von Produkten und Produkteerweiterungen in der Rolle als Product ManagerIn.

• Ausarbeitung von Entscheidungsgrundlagen rund um Produkteentwicklungen für Arbeitsgruppen

Das bringst du mit

• Stark ausgeprägte konzeptionelle Fähigkeit und Freude, konzipierte Lösungen zu vermitteln sowie die Umsetzung voranzutreiben.

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten sowie das Talent, Konsens hinsichtlich Lösungen herzustellen.

• Gute Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten, um die Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zu fördern.

• Erfahrung im Bereich von digitalen Lösungen im Zahlungsverkehr; bevorzugt als Product ManagerIn sind von Vorteil.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Mateusz Kozielec unter der Nummer +41583998611.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

SIX dirige la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous rend différents nous fait avancer : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits intelligents et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir des marchés financiers avec nous.

(Junior) Gestionnaire de produits Paiements

Zurich: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% possible

Voulez-vous travailler dans un environnement passionnant et aider à façonner la numérisation en Suisse ? Après votre formation, avez-vous déjà acquis une expérience initiale dans le domaine de la gestion de produits ou des transactions de paiement? Le développement de produits et son impact sur les résultats commerciaux sont-ils votre passion? Êtes-vous intéressé par le développement futur des transactions de paiement? Alors notre équipe de gestion de produits veut vous entendre !

Nous sommes une équipe ambitieuse et dynamique responsable du développement de différentes solutions pour le centre financier suisse. En tant que gestionnaire de produits, vous faites partie de la gestion de produits de la plateforme de paiement SIC et vous assurez que nos systèmes sont disponibles pour les banques en Suisse à tout moment et traitent des millions de transactions efficacement chaque jour. Dans une équipe interdisciplinaire et en interaction avec les acteurs internes et externes, vous vous assurerez que la Suisse dispose de solutions de pointe au niveau mondial dans le traitement des paiements et se développe progressivement vers les paiements instantanés.

Ce sont vos tâches

• Vous vous déplacez dans la communauté bancaire, développez des solutions viables avec des bureaux internes ou dans des groupes de travail et transmettez vos propres positions avec éclat.

• Conception des fonctions et poursuite du développement des solutions existantes.

• Création de concepts d'entreprise pour le développement de produits stratégiques.

• Soutien des équipes informatiques dans la phase de développement et de mise en œuvre des produits et des extensions de produits dans le rôle de gestionnaire de produits.

• Élaboration de principes décisionnels concernant le développement de produits pour les groupes de travail

Apporte ça avec toi.

• Forte capacité conceptuelle et plaisir à communiquer des solutions conçues et à conduire la mise en œuvre.

• Des compétences de communication et de présentation solides ainsi que le talent pour construire un consensus sur les solutions.

• Bonnes compétences en gestion des intervenants pour encourager la collaboration avec les intervenants internes et externes.

• expérience dans les solutions de paiement numérique; Préféré en tant que gestionnaire de produits sont avantageux.

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture. La connaissance du français est un avantage.

Si vous avez des questions, visitez notre page FAQ ou contactez Mateusz Kozielec au +41583998611.

Pour cette vacance, nous ne considérons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous, et nous accueillons donc favorablement les applications sans égard à leurs antécédents personnels.

Testing Manager

Madrid, Barcelona | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8056

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Testing Lead in Madrid to join our Clearing IT team. This is an exciting opportunity for a QA professional who thrives in complex environments and wants to play a key role in shaping quality across business-critical initiatives. In this role, you will define, implement, and lead testing strategies and quality standards for projects and change requests, helping to deliver high-quality, compliant software in a collaborative and international setting. Fluency in English is mandatory, and proficiency in Spanish is highly preferred.

We are looking forward to meet you. Apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Define and drive a comprehensive test strategy covering functional, non-functional, and regression testing to support successful project delivery and high-quality outcomes.

• Lead QA activities for change requests related to continuous enhancements and maintenance within Clearing applications, ensuring quality standards are met and releases are delivered with confidence throughout the year.

• Establish and oversee an effective defect management process in JIRA, working closely with development and business teams to ensure timely resolution and continuous quality improvement.

• Facilitate regular test management meetings to review progress, resolve concerns, and keep stakeholders aligned on delivery goals and change priorities.

• Identify risks early and proactively escalate critical issues to project management to support informed decisions and timely resolution.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations, fostering seamless teamwork and aligning testing activities with project milestones and release plans.

What You Bring

• A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in test management, including responsibility for medium to large or complex projects, with end-to-end ownership of test strategy, execution oversight, defect management, and quality assurance governance.

• A proven track record of successfully leading test management activities across multiple releases or projects and delivering strong quality outcomes in complex environments.

• Solid understanding of Waterfall, Agile, and SAFe methodologies, with the flexibility to adapt testing approaches to different delivery models.

• Experience in coordinating and leading a team of more than six testers, providing guidance, structure, and support to achieve shared quality goals.

• Strong proficiency in JIRA for test management, change request tracking, and transparent documentation of defects, resolutions, and project progress.

• Fluency in both verbal and written English.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Specialista della conformità dei dati

London | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8086

Sei pronto a fare un impatto nel mondo frenetico dei dati finanziari? Unisciti al nostro team di Global Risk, Regulatory & Rights Management di SIX e aiuta a plasmare il nostro ambizioso viaggio di crescita.

In questo ruolo dinamico e versatile, si prende possesso di Data Compliance, consigliando sui requisiti SIX e Data Fornitore attraverso progetti e operazioni. Analizzi l'utilizzo dei dati dei clienti, i flussi di dati e le configurazioni delle soluzioni per garantire strutture chiare e conformi e tradurre intuizioni nella documentazione pratica e facile da usare. Contribuisci anche alle attività di Customer Due Diligence e supporta le Audit dei fornitori di dati.

In qualità di esperto di fiducia, si lavora a stretto contatto sia con i team che con quelli interni, giocando un ruolo chiave nella nostra catena del valore di consegna dei dati.

Stiamo cercando qualcuno guidato, organizzato e motivato, che gode di lavorare indipendentemente, prende la proprietà, ed è desideroso di crescere, avere successo e dare un contributo significativo. La competenza in MS Excel, SQL e un approccio pragmatico e pratico vi permetterà di fornire risultati pratici e di alta qualità.

Cosa farai

• Analizzare i pacchetti di dati dei fornitori di dati e gli accordi di licenza sui diritti di proprietà intellettuale

• Sostenere la creazione di documentazione che dimostri il coinvolgimento dei partner nelle consegne SIX a clienti finali.

• Notifica commerciale del cliente, suggerisci modifiche per una chiara comprensione del cliente.

• Assumere la responsabilità e guidare Vendite, Gestione licenze di dati e il team di operazioni dei clienti sui termini e condizioni del fornitore di dati

• Partecipare a progetti come esperto di materia, fornendo consulenza su SIX framework contrattuali e Termini e Condizioni del Fornitore di dati.

Che cosa porta

• Master o laurea con la conoscenza del lavoro di argomenti quali dati di mercato, dati di riferimento, fornitori di dati e gestione delle informazioni

• Minimo di 5-7 anni di esperienza all'interno dei servizi finanziari, almeno 3 dei quali lavorano in un team di dati di mercato che dimostra una forte conoscenza dei fornitori di dati di mercato e dei fornitori

• Alto impegno nei metodi di lavoro qualitativi, affidabili, strutturati e indipendenti

• Dimostrare competenze tecniche efficaci al fine di colmare le esigenze aziendali e tecniche di ruolo

• L'attenzione del cliente e le buone capacità di comunicazione con il tedesco, il francese e/o lo spagnolo sono un'ulteriore risorsa

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Anthony Mills al numero +44 207 550 5407 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Business Analyst

Would you like to dive into the fascinating world of equities, corporate action and structured products? As part of a team of specialists, you will analyze and specify requirements for content covering shares and warrants, and ensure accurate handling of corporate actions (e.g., dividends, rights issues) for French Products, Finalim and PGD. You’ll translate all changes sourced from VDF and main primary sources (e.g., Euronext, Euroclear) into clear, testable specifications that drive high quality data for our FR Products and clients.

What You Will Do

• Collaborate closely with the Data Operations team dedicated to French products. Gather all their requirements, evaluate them, prioritize them, and implement appropriate solutions to address them in close collaboration with the CIT teams dedicated to French products.

• Own data mapping, validation, and control frameworks for corporate actions and distributions, ensuring compliance with relevant regulatory and tax rules.

• Design and maintain reference linkages across issuers, index components, and economic sector classifications to support downstream analytics and reporting.

• Collaborate with Product Owners, engineering, QA, and operations; author user stories, acceptance criteria, and test cases; support business/UAT and release readiness.

What You Bring

• 2–5 years of business analysis experience in financial information.

• Strong knowledge of equity markets, warrants/structured products, and corporate action lifecycles.

• Understanding of taxation and regulations impacting FR products (PGD and Finalim) and clients.

• Experience with content/data modeling, instrument identifiers (e.g., ISIN), and classification frameworks (e.g., financial sector codes).

• Proficiency with SQL and Excel; ability to translate business needs into clear specifications for analysts, developers, and architects.

• Exposure to agile practices (Jira, confluence), documentation and testing methodologies

• Knowledge of GitLab is appreciated.

• Fluent English (B2/C1) & French (B2) are mandatory. Comfortable communicating in a global, cross functional environment.

Senior Cyber Security Resilience Specialist

Varsavia | Fino al 40% di lavoro da casa possibile | Riferimento 8163

Cyber Security Resilience Specialist è responsabile per il miglioramento continuo e l'efficacia operativa dei servizi di Cyber Security Resilience, con un focus primario sul monitoraggio dell'integrità file (FIM), Secure Configuration Baselines (SCB), e Vulnerability Management (VM).

Il ruolo funge da esperto di materia, guidando la maturità dei controlli di resilienza, assicurando la conformità normativa, sostenendo la disponibilità di audit e le principali iniziative tecniche nel panorama della sicurezza aziendale. I partner di posizione con i team di infrastruttura, piattaforma, ingegneria, rischio e conformità per garantire le capacità di resilienza informatica rimangono efficaci, scalabili e allineati alle aspettative normative. L'individuo dovrebbe fornire competenze tecniche e contribuire all'evoluzione strategica delle operazioni di monitoraggio e vulnerabilità della sicurezza.

Cosa farai

• Contribuisci a migliorare continuamente i servizi di Cyber Security Resilience relativi a: File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Secure Configuration Baselines (SCB), Vulnerability Management (VM)

• Definire standard operativi, processi e miglioramenti KPI per i controlli di resilienza.

• Guidare l'adozione di best practice di sicurezza informatica e requisiti normativi in tutta l'organizzazione.

• Assicurarsi che i controlli di resilienza rimangano allineati con i paesaggi di minaccia in evoluzione e i requisiti aziendali.

• Fornire competenze di materia per le piattaforme e i processi FIM, SCB e Vulnerability Management.

• Guidare la distribuzione, l'ottimizzazione e la valorizzazione delle capacità di monitoraggio della sicurezza.

• Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo per migliorare la qualità dei dati, la copertura di monitoraggio e la visibilità dei rischi.

• Supporta la gestione del ciclo di vita della piattaforma, compresi gli aggiornamenti, l'imbarco di nuovi asset e miglioramenti strategici.

• Analizzare le tendenze della vulnerabilità, i livelli di esposizione e l'efficacia della correzione in tutto l'ambiente.

• Impegnatevi direttamente con i team tecnologici per dare priorità e guidare le attività di bonifica.

• Sviluppare e mantenere metodologie di gestione delle vulnerabilità basate sui rischi.

• Produrre report esecutivi e tecnici per gli stakeholder senior.

• Contribuisci all'implementazione e alla governance della SCB in base ai Benchmark CIS e alle best practice del settore.

• Valutare la conformità della linea di base tra infrastrutture e ambienti applicativi.

• Collabora con i team di ingegneria per migliorare la postura della conformità della configurazione generale.

• Definire e mantenere le strategie di monitoraggio FIM, le politiche e le soglie di avviso.

• Condurre analisi avanzate degli eventi di monitoraggio dell'integrità e identificare i rischi di sicurezza rilevanti.

• Miglioramento dell'unità per monitorare la copertura e le capacità di rilevamento.

• Agire come principale contatto tecnico per audit interni ed esterni, tra cui: FINMA, DORA, Internal Audit, Recensioni normative esterne

• Assicurare la prontezza di audit continua attraverso una solida gestione delle prove e la validazione del controllo.

• Interpretare i requisiti normativi e tradurli in controlli tecnici e operativi.

• Sostenere le valutazioni dei rischi e controllare le recensioni sull'efficacia.

Che cosa porta

• 5+ anni di esperienza in Cyber Security, sicurezza delle infrastrutture o ingegneria della sicurezza.

• Forte esperienza pratica in: Gestione della vulnerabilità, Baseline di configurazione sicura (CIS Benchmarks), Monitoraggio dell'integrità file

• Forte comprensione di: sicurezza Windows e Linux, principi di sicurezza cloud, ingegneria di monitoraggio e rilevamento di sicurezza, automazione di sicurezza e orchestrazione

• Esperienza con l'implementazione e la governance del controllo di sicurezza su scala aziendale.

• Esperienza all'interno di settori regolamentati come i servizi bancari o finanziari.

• Conoscenza delle strutture FINMA, DORA, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls o simili.

• Esperienza di integrazione delle piattaforme di sicurezza attraverso API e automazione.

• Esposizione a SIEM, Cortex XSOAR, Elastic Stack e pratiche di rilevamento delle minacce.

• Capacità di tradurre questioni tecniche complesse in insight rilevanti per il business.

• Autodidatta e capace di operare in modo indipendente.

• Forte mentalità di proprietà e responsabilità.

• Eccellente gestione delle parti interessate e influenzare le competenze.

• Capacità di condurre iniziative attraverso più squadre e confini organizzativi.

• Mente di miglioramento continuo con un focus sull'automazione e l'eccellenza operativa.

Senior Cyber Security Resilience Specialist

Cyber Security Resilience Specialist is responsible for continuous improvement, and operational effectiveness of Cyber Security Resilience services, with a primary focus on File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Secure Configuration Baselines (SCB), and Vulnerability Management (VM).

The role acts as a subject matter expert, driving the maturity of resilience controls, ensuring regulatory compliance, supporting audit readiness, and leading technical initiatives across the enterprise security landscape. The position partners with infrastructure, platform, engineering, risk, and compliance teams to ensure cyber resilience capabilities remain effective, scalable, and aligned with regulatory expectations. The individual is expected to provide technical expertise and contribute to the strategic evolution of security monitoring and vulnerability operations.

What You Will Do

• Contribute to continuously improve Cyber Security Resilience services related to: File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Secure Configuration Baselines (SCB), Vulnerability Management (VM)

• Define operational standards, processes and KPI improvements for resilience controls.

• Drive the adoption of cybersecurity best practices and regulatory requirements across the organization.

• Ensure resilience controls remain aligned with evolving threat landscapes and business requirements.

• Provide subject matter expertise for FIM, SCB, and Vulnerability Management platforms and processes.

• Lead the deployment, optimization, and enhancement of security monitoring capabilities.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance data quality, monitoring coverage, and risk visibility.

• Support platform lifecycle management, including upgrades, onboarding of new assets, and strategic enhancements.

• Analyze vulnerability trends, exposure levels, and remediation effectiveness across the environment.

• Engage directly with technology teams to prioritize and drive remediation activities.

• Develop and maintain risk-based vulnerability management methodologies.

• Produce executive and technical reporting for senior stakeholders.

• Contribute to SCB implementation and governance based on CIS Benchmarks and industry best practices.

• Assess baseline compliance across infrastructure and application environments.

• Partner with engineering teams to improve overall configuration compliance posture.

• Define and maintain FIM monitoring strategies, policies, and alerting thresholds.

• Conduct advanced analysis of integrity monitoring events and identify relevant security risks.

• Drive enhancements to monitoring coverage and detection capabilities.

• Act as the primary technical contact for internal and external audits including: FINMA, DORA, Internal Audit, External Regulatory Reviews

• Ensure continuous audit readiness through robust evidence management and control validation.

• Interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into technical and operational controls.

• Support risk assessments and control effectiveness reviews.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of experience in Cyber Security, Infrastructure Security, or Security Engineering.

• Strong hands-on experience in: Vulnerability Management, Secure Configuration Baselines (CIS Benchmarks), File Integrity Monitoring

• Strong understanding of: Windows and Linux security, Cloud security principles, Security monitoring and detection engineering, Security automation and orchestration

• Experience with enterprise-scale security control implementation and governance.

• Experience within regulated industries such as Banking or Financial Services.

• Knowledge of FINMA, DORA, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, or similar frameworks.

• Experience integrating security platforms through APIs and automation.

• Exposure to SIEM, Cortex XSOAR, Elastic Stack and threat detection engineering practices.

• Ability to translate complex technical issues into business-relevant insights.

• Self-driven and capable of operating independently.

• Strong ownership mindset and accountability.

• Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.

• Ability to lead initiatives across multiple teams and organizational boundaries.

• Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on automation and operational excellence.

• English – Fluent (mandatory)

• German – Strong advantage

Die Position ist eine Partnerschaft mit Infrastruktur-, Plattform-, Engineering-, Risiko- und Compliance-Teams, um sicherzustellen, dass die Cyber-Resilienzfähigkeiten effektiv, skalierbar und an den regulatorischen Erwartungen ausgerichtet bleiben. Was Sie tun werden

• Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Cyber Security Resilience Services im Zusammenhang mit: File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Secure Configuration Baselines (SCB), Vulnerability Management (VM)

• Führen Sie die Einführung von Best Practices und regulatorischen Anforderungen für Cybersicherheit im gesamten Unternehmen voran.

• Förderung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsinitiativen zur Verbesserung der Datenqualität, Überwachung der Abdeckung und Risikosichtbarkeit.

• Unterstützung des Platform Lifecycle Managements, einschließlich Upgrades, Onboarding neuer Assets und strategischer Verbesserungen.

• Analysieren Sie Schwachstellentrends, Expositionsniveaus und die Wirksamkeit der Sanierung in der gesamten Umgebung.

• Engagieren Sie sich direkt mit Technologieteams, um Sanierungsaktivitäten zu priorisieren und voranzutreiben.

• Entwicklung und Pflege risikobasierter Vulnerabilitätsmanagementmethoden.

• Erstellen Sie Executive und Technical Reporting für Senior Stakeholder.

• Beitrag zur SCB-Implementierung und -Governance auf der Grundlage von CIS-Benchmarks und Best Practices der Branche.

• Bewerten Sie die Baseline-Compliance in Infrastruktur- und Anwendungsumgebungen.

• Partnerschaft mit Engineering-Teams zur Verbesserung der Gesamtkonfiguration Compliance-Haltung.

• Definieren und pflegen Sie FIM-Überwachungsstrategien, -richtlinien und Alarmschwellen.

• Führen Sie eine erweiterte Analyse von Integritätsüberwachungsereignissen durch und identifizieren Sie relevante Sicherheitsrisiken.

• Verbesserung der Überwachungsabdeckung und der Erkennungsfunktionen.

• Als primärer technischer Ansprechpartner für interne und externe Audits tätig, darunter: FINMA, DORA, Interne Revision, Externe Regulatory Reviews

• Gewährleistung der kontinuierlichen Auditbereitschaft durch robustes Beweismanagement und Validierung von Kontrollen.

• Interpretieren Sie regulatorische Anforderungen und übersetzen Sie sie in technische und betriebliche Kontrollen.

• Unterstützung von Risikobewertungen und Überprüfungen der Wirksamkeit von Kontrollen.

Are you passionate about building marketing automation at an enterprise level and driving measurable business impact? Do you thrive in an international environment and enjoy shaping strategy, customer journeys, and data-driven decisions? Then join our international Digital team as Senior Marketing Automation Specialist.

In this role, you will own and further develop our business Marketing Automation strategy in Marketo, with a strong focus on generating Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) and supporting sales opportunity creation. You will define and optimize lifecycle communications across email and other relevant channels.

You will act as the strategic driver behind targeting, segmentation, personalization, lifecycle design, attribution, and performance measurement. In doing so, you will define business requirements and work closely with IT, Data teams, and the Marketo Application Manager.

With your deep expertise in Marketing Automation, you will also steer and mentor a Junior Marketing Automation Manager.

We invest in the development of our experts and support you in continuously expanding your skills, both strategically and technically.

As a modern, innovative company at the intersection of technology and finance, SIX offers a wide range of opportunities to make a meaningful impact and fully leverage your potential.
We look forward to receiving your application in English.

What You Will Do

• Define and own the end-to-end business Marketing Automation strategy in Marketo, translating business objectives into clear automation use cases, roadmaps and success metrics, while aligning with platform capabilities.

• Define and optimize B2B email marketing and omnichannel engagement strategies, ensuring that nurturing, lifecycle communications, and automated journeys are relevant and aligned with business objectives across the customer journey.

• Design, implement, and optimize marketing automation frameworks (lead scoring, lead qualification, nurturing) and continuously improve targeting, segmentation, and personalization to drive Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs).

• Define and manage attribution models in Marketo, and contribute to holistic performance reporting by connecting Marketo data with Google Data Studio dashboards.

• Act as strategic owner and senior stakeholder interface for Marketing Automation, leading governance across internal teams (Compliance, Marketing, Sales, Tech, Data, IT) and external partners, while steering and and coaching one Junior Marketing Automation Manager.

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communication, Marketing, Media, Public Relations, or a comparable field.

• 5+ years of experience in Marketing Automation, with proven ownership of enterprise‑scale Marketo setups and the ability to define and drive marketing automation strategy beyond campaign execution.

• Strong experience in B2B email marketing, lifecycle communications and omnichannel campaign orchestration, including segmentation, personalization, testing, engagement optimization and email best practices.

• Deep expert knowledge of Marketo, including architecture, lead scoring and qualification models, lifecycle management, attribution, reporting, and governance, with a strong focus on SQL and sales opportunity generation.

• Analytical and attribution skills, including defining attribution models in Marketo and connecting Marketo data to Google Data Studio dashboards.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Business Analyst - Market Data & Entitlements (with French) Warsaw | working from home up to 40% | Reference 7630 Would you like to dive into the fascinating world of market data? As part of a team of specialists you will help build and operate reliable market data and entitlement flows for French Products (Finalim, PGD, Europerf). You will analyze and specify requirements for pricing and reference content sourced from MDF Stream/MDF Select, IPS and some direct contributors. You will ensure this content is normalized, high quality, and distributed to all French Products and clients with the correct licensing and access controls. Working closely with product, engineering, operations, and QA, you’ll translate MDF and IPS specifications and market rules into clear, testable documentation that enables accurate data delivery. You will occupy a central position between two data models (Global and FR) that allow French products to fully benefit from the rich market data of the global model. What You Will Do
• Gather and document the functional and non-functional requirements of real-time and end-of-day price data feeds, as well as the repositories provided by MDF and IPS, to cover all the needs of French products (Finalim, PGD, Europerf). Define the standardization, enrichment, and validation rules.
• Design and maintain entitlement models and content distribution rules for French products, ensuring compliance with provider licensing and contractual constraints.
• Support onboarding and certification of new/changed feeds from MDF and IPS. Coordinate test scenarios, ensure their validation and non-regression across the entire system.
• Investigate incidents and drive corrective actions with providers and internal teams.
• Contribute to market data documentation & standards and process improvements across all delivery channels for French Products (MDF, IPS, Finalim, PGD, Europerf, and TDI for entitlement). What You Bring
• 2–5 years of business analysis experience in market data or financial information.
• Strong understanding of market data concepts, normalization, and data quality controls.
• Experience with market data providers and feeds. Knowledge of access rights frameworks and models, data distribution flows, and licensing obligations.
• Ability to translate business rules into technical specifications and test cases; solid documentation skills.
• Proficiency with SQL and Excel; familiarity with APIs and file-based delivery; comfortable collaborating with product, engineering, QA, and operations.
• Exposure to agile methods (e.g., Jira/Azure DevOps) and quality assurance practices (UAT, regression).
• Fluent English (B2/C1) & French (B2) are mandatory. Comfortable communicating in a global, cross functional environment. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Are you eager to learn, bring new ideas, and tackle challenges in a modern DevOps setup? We are looking for an Application DevOps Engineer focused on automated cloud deployments and container platforms. In this role, you will support development teams by designing and operating Kubernetes/OpenShift platforms, automating infrastructure and deployment processes, providing standardized CI/CD pipelines, and configuring shared operational services. Working with tools like Kubernetes, OpenShift, Argo CD, GitLab, Ansible, and container registries, you will help build scalable release processes, improve deployment reliability, and ensure consistent ado ption of DevOps and GitOps best practices. DevOps Engineer - Containerization & Cloud

Barcelona, Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7624

Do you want to work in an agile environment where passion, trust, innovation, and operational excellence drive everything we do? SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari. Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Supporto per il Team Studente di Lavoro - Enterprise Architecture & IT Governance (40-60%) Zurigo | 40-60% | Riferimento 8105 Stai cercando un'opportunità per acquisire esperienza pratica accanto ai tuoi studi per sfidarti in un ambiente internazionale? Poi unisciti al nostro team Enterprise Architecture & IT Governance di SIX, un fornitore leader di infrastrutture di mercato finanziario che serve il centro finanziario svizzero. Come studente di lavoro, acquisirai preziose informazioni sul lavoro quotidiano di Enterprise Architecture e IT Governance, supportando iniziative di comunicazione, attività di coordinamento, documentazione e processi operativi. Questo ruolo offre esperienza pratica e l'esposizione ad una vasta gamma di argomenti all'incrocio tra business e IT. Forniamo un ambiente di lavoro di supporto con opportunità di crescita personale e professionale, insieme con la possibilità di un membro nella Comunità SIX NextGen. Cosa farai
• Contribuire alle iniziative di comunicazione relative all'architettura aziendale e preparare materiali come presentazioni, mappe degli stakeholder e framework di comunicazione
• Supporta i processi operativi in Enterprise Architecture Management (EAM) tra cui la manutenzione e la struttura dei dati e della documentazione
• Preparare le presentazioni strutturando i dati e traducendolo in visualizzazioni e sintesi di gestione
• Organizza eventi interni (ad esempio Giornata dell'Architettura e workshop)
• Coordinare le riunioni, compresa la programmazione e l'allineamento dei partecipanti Che cosa porta
• Attualmente perseguire una laurea o Master in Informatica aziendale, Business Administration, comunicazioni, o un campo correlato
• Forte capacità organizzative e di comunicazione con un modo strutturato di lavorare
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e gestire più attività contemporaneamente
• Proficienza in Microsoft Office, in particolare PowerPoint ed Excel
• Fluente in inglese e tedesco; lo spagnolo è un vantaggio Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Janine Reichling al numero +41 58 399 42 99 . Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Working Student Team Support - Enterprise Architecture & IT Governance (40-60%)

Zurich | 40-60% | Reference 8105

Are you looking for an opportunity to gain practical experience alongside your studies to challenge yourself in an international environment? Then join our Enterprise Architecture & IT Governance team at SIX, a leading financial market infrastructure provider serving the Swiss financial center.

As a Working Student, you will gain valuable insights into the day-to-day work of Enterprise Architecture and IT Governance while supporting communication initiatives, coordination activities, documentation, and operational processes. This role offers hands-on experience and exposure to a wide range of topics at the intersection of business and IT. We provide a supportive working environment with opportunities for personal and professional growth, along with the option for a Membership in the SIX NextGen Community.

What You Will Do

• Contribute to communication initiatives related to Enterprise Architecture and prepare materials such as presentations, stakeholder maps, and communication frameworks

• Support operational processes in Enterprise Architecture Management (EAM) including the maintenance and structure of data and documentation

• Prepare presentations by structuring data and translating it into visualizations and management summaries

• Organize internal events (e.g. Architecture Day and workshops)

• Coordinate meetings, including scheduling and participant alignment

What You Bring

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Informatics, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field

• Strong organizational and communication skills with a structured way of working

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel

• Fluent in English and German; Spanish is an advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Janine Reichling at +41 58 399 42 99 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Ensuite, rejoignez notre équipe d'architecture d'entreprise et de gouvernance informatique chez SIX, un fournisseur d'infrastructure leader des marchés financiers desservant le centre financier suisse. • Compétence dans Microsoft Office, en particulier PowerPoint et Excel
• Fluent en anglais et en allemand; l'espagnol est un avantage Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Janine Reichling au +41 58 399 42 99 . Sei interessato al settore Comunicazione e Marketing e alla ricerca di un interessante stage per saperne di più sul settore finanziario? Se la vostra risposta è sì, il nostro team Eventi e Conferenze, responsabile di eventi e visite guidate al Palacio de la Bolsa, vi incontrerà. Siamo alla ricerca di una persona luminosa e dedicata che si diverte a lavorare in una squadra e vuole fare uno stage pomeridiano a BME, dove fornire assistenza pratica nella zona Eventi e Conferenze. La funzione si baserà al Palacio de la Bolsa de Madrid (Plaza de la Lealtad, 1). Non esitare e applica ora con il tuo CV in inglese. Cosa farai
• effettuare le visite guidate, supervisionare la casella di posta e rispondere alle richieste di visite guidate, amministrare e gestire tutte le richieste in arrivo (mail / telefono)
• collaborazione nello sviluppo dei materiali e dei discorsi per le visite guidate, acquisendo conoscenze e storia legate al mercato azionario e ai suoi dintorni (Stock Exchange Palace)
• sostenere i responsabili degli eventi in tutti gli aspetti della gestione degli eventi (pianificazione, preparazione, esecuzione, materiale evento, gestione degli inviti e registrazione, ecc.)
• fornire supporto ad hoc al team eventi nel loro lavoro quotidiano
• supporto on-Site agli eventi Che cosa porta
• studi in Marketing, Comunicazione, Turismo, Amministrazione Bussines o Organizzazione Evento e disponibilità per i pomeriggi (da 14 a 19h Lunedì a Venerdì)
• capacità di lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e globale con eccellenti capacità organizzative e di comunicazione
• forti capacità organizzative e flessibilità personale
• disponibilità a collaborare e lavorare autonomamente abbinato a buone capacità di gestione del tempo

Senior Software Analyst & Developer

Madrid, Barcelona | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8109

Join our team and play a key role in shaping the future of European Clearing services. As a Software Analyst & Developer, you will work at the heart of a business-critical Clearing ecosystem, supporting and evolving complex applications while contributing to the development of a next-generation, unified Clearing platform, working with Oracle, PL/SQL, Java, and modern architectures. You will play a key role in ensuring the stability, performance, and evolution of a complex financial ecosystem in an international environment. The hiring could be either in Madrid or in Barcelona.

What You Will Do

• Develop a deep understanding of the Clearing applications ecosystem, including core business flows, data models, and system dependencies.

• Design, develop, and maintain robust PL/SQL solutions to support critical Clearing processes, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.

• Analyse, troubleshoot, and resolve complex production incidents, acting as part of the L3 support model for business-critical applications.

• Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes to prevent recurrence, contributing to system stability and continuous improvement.

• Participate in support activities outside business hours, including resolution of high-priority incidents affecting Clearing operations.

• Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to evolve legacy systems, contributing to modernization initiatives and integration with new architectures (e.g., microservices).

• Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and handover processes, ensuring long-term maintainability and team autonomy.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, operations, and risk teams to ensure efficient and compliant operation of Clearing services.

• Contribute to the re-architecture, analysis and development of the next-generation Clearing platform, supporting the integration and consolidation of European Clearing systems into a unified ecosystem.

What You Bring

• Strong expertise in Oracle databases and advanced PL/SQL development, with proven experience in complex data processing and performance optimization.

• Solid background in application and system architecture, especially in complex legacy environments.

• Understanding of the Clearing business domain will be a plus

• Experience with Java (microservices architecture) and Linux environments.

• Native Spanish and advanced level of English (C1), both written and spoken.

• Availability to perform planned support activities outside standard working hours, when required. This is extra compensated.

• Willingness to participate in a 24/7 on-call support rotation, covering full weeks (approximately one week per month) and to cover some bank holidays (aprox. 6 per year). This services are extra compensated.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

• Starke Expertise in Oracle-Datenbanken und fortschrittliche PL/SQL-Entwicklung mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung in der komplexen Datenverarbeitung und Leistungsoptimierung.

• Verfügbarkeit für geplante Unterstützungsaktivitäten außerhalb der üblichen Arbeitszeiten, falls erforderlich. Dies wird extra kompensiert.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - conduit la transformation des marchés financiers et appartient à SIX, le troisième groupe de change en Europe. Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Analyste et développeur logiciel senior Madrid, Barcelone Rejoignez notre équipe et jouez un rôle clé pour façonner l'avenir des services européens de compensation. En tant qu'analyste et développeur de logiciels, vous travaillerez au cœur d'un écosystème de Clearing critique pour les affaires, soutenant et développant des applications complexes tout en contribuant au développement d'une plateforme de Clearing unifiée de nouvelle génération, travaillant avec Oracle, PL/SQL, Java et des architectures modernes. Vous jouerez un rôle clé pour assurer la stabilité, la performance et l'évolution d'un écosystème financier complexe dans un environnement international. L'embauche pourrait être soit à Madrid, soit à Barcelone. Ce que vous ferez
• Développer une compréhension approfondie de l'écosystème des applications Clearing, y compris les flux d'affaires essentiels, les modèles de données et les dépendances du système.
• Concevoir, développer et maintenir des solutions de PL/SQL robustes pour soutenir les processus de Clearing critiques, en assurant la performance, l'évolutivité et la fiabilité.
• Analyser, dépanner et résoudre des incidents de production complexes, agissant dans le cadre du modèle de support L3 pour les applications critiques pour l'entreprise.
• Effectuer une analyse des causes profondes et mettre en oeuvre des correctifs permanents pour prévenir les récidives, contribuant à la stabilité du système et à l'amélioration continue.
• Participer à des activités de soutien en dehors des heures d'ouverture, y compris la résolution d'incidents hautement prioritaires touchant les opérations de compensation.
• Collaborer avec les architectes et les équipes d'ingénierie pour faire évoluer les systèmes existants, contribuer aux initiatives de modernisation et s'intégrer aux nouvelles architectures (p. ex., les microservices).
• Contribuer à la documentation technique, au partage des connaissances et aux processus de transfert, en assurant la maintenance à long terme et l'autonomie de l'équipe.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants, les opérations et les équipes de gestion des risques afin d'assurer le fonctionnement efficace et conforme des services de compensation.
• Contribuer à la refonte, à l'analyse et au développement de la plate-forme de Clearing de la prochaine génération, en soutenant l'intégration et la consolidation des systèmes de Clearing européens dans un écosystème unifié. Ce que vous apportez
• Forte expertise dans les bases de données Oracle et le développement avancé PL/SQL, avec une expérience éprouvée dans le traitement de données complexes et l'optimisation des performances.
• Fond solide dans l'architecture de l'application et du système, en particulier dans les environnements anciens complexes.
• La compréhension du domaine d'activité de Clearing sera un plus
• Expérience des environnements Java (architecture microservices) et Linux.
• Espagnol autochtone et niveau avancé d'anglais (C1), à la fois écrit et parlé.
• Disponibilité pour effectuer les activités de soutien prévues en dehors des heures de travail normales, au besoin. C'est une compensation supplémentaire.
• Volonté de participer à une rotation de soutien 24/7 sur appel, couvrant des semaines complètes (environ une semaine par mois) et couvrant certains jours fériés (environ 6 par an). Ces services sont rémunérés en supplément. Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Sara Perez de la Cuesta au +34 91 709 56 80 . Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes. La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

IT & Quantitative Risk Engineering Analyst

Madrid | 100% | Riferimento 8144

Come IT & Quantitative Risk Engineering di SIX Clearing, sarai un membro chiave del nostro team di Financial Quantitative Risk Management. La vostra responsabilità primaria è garantire la stabilità, l'automazione e l'affidabilità delle piattaforme tecniche che supportano la gestione dei rischi quantitativi.

Il ruolo si concentra principalmente sull'ingegneria IT, sulle piattaforme di dati e sull'eccellenza operativa (≈70–80%), contribuendo a processi di rischio quantitativi (≈20–30%), garantendo dati e infrastrutture robuste, scalabili e di alta qualità in un ambiente mission-critical.

Cosa farai

• Progettazione, ottimizzazione e manutenzione database SQL Server (tavole, visualizzazioni, procedure memorizzate, automazione dei carichi di dati)

• Sviluppare ed eseguire tubazioni ETL basate su Python per l'ingestione, la convalida e il controllo di qualità dei dati finanziari

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Application IT Analyst (Quant Risk)

Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8144

As an IT & Quantitative Risk Engineering of SIX Clearing, you will you will be a key member of our Financial Quantitative Risk Management team. Your primary responsibility is to ensure the stability, automation, and reliability of the technical platforms supporting quantitative risk management.

The role is primarily focused on IT engineering, data platforms, and operational excellence ensuring robust, scalable, and high-quality data and infrastructure in a mission-critical environment (≈70–80%). In addition, it contributes to enhancing the existing quantitative risk methodologies framework in compliance with the Regulation, and according to the SIX Group risk policies, procedures and best practices in terms of risk management (≈20–30%).

What You Will Do

• Design, optimize, and maintain SQL Server databases (tables, views, stored procedures, automation of data loads)

• Develop and run Python-based ETL pipelines for ingestion, validation, and quality control of financial data

• Integrate and manage market data flows from external (e.g., Reuters) and internal providers

• Build and maintain automated risk calculation processes supporting Quant teams in production

• Ensure platform reliability (Windows servers, monitoring, patching, incident resolution) and support containerized environments (Docker)

• Implement and operate DevOps practices (Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments) while supporting critical IT services continuity

• Developing, calibrating, implementing and reviewing quantitative risk models, stress- and back-tests, scenario analysis to ensure SIX Clearing resilience to adverse market conditions

What You Bring

• Strong experience in IT engineering / data platforms / infrastructure, preferably in financial or regulated environments

• Advanced expertise in SQL Server (data modeling, performance tuning, automation)

• Solid programming skills in Python (ETL, data processing, automation)

• Hands-on experience with DevOps tools (Git, CI/CD, containerization such as Docker)

• Understanding of financial data and basic Quant risk concepts, with ability to support quantitative processes

• Strong analytical mindset, reliability under pressure, collaborative and ability to operate in mission-critical environments

• Good communication skills in English and Spanish to interact with international colleagues and stakeholders

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Senior AI Backend Engineer Madrid, Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7655 Join SIX Financial Information's AI Engineering team as a Senior AI Backend Engineer of our Productization squad. You will own the backend, APIs, and integrations that turn AI prototypes into production-grade products in our GenAI and Data Mining lines. This is a high-leverage, player-coach role at the heart of how we scale AI delivery. You will set the technical direction for production-grade engineering, partner with data scientists and AI engineers on serving and integration patterns, and free the AI Solutions team to focus on models and evals while your squad owns reliable delivery to end users What You Will Do
• Productize AI & GenAI Solutions: Build the backends, agent/RAG infrastructure, MCP servers, and LLM-serving layers that turn models, prompts, and pipelines into reliable, observable production products.
• Design & Build Production APIs: Architect and maintain endpoints and GraphQL APIs, defining schema, resolver, and authentication patterns that serve frontend applications, internal services, and AI features.
• Integrate Data & AI Pipelines: Develop ingestion, parsing, OCR, and vendor-LLM integrations (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) with strong attention to concurrency, async processing, retries, idempotency, and state-machine workflows.
• Operate in Production: Partner with MLOps on Docker, Terraform, and Azure DevOps CI/CD; establish performance baselines and observability for both APIs and AI workloads; optimize for latency, throughput, and cost.
• Champion Quality & Coach Peers: Apply clean architecture and proven design patterns, enforce standards through tests and reviews, and coach junior engineers and rotating contributors. What You Bring
• Backend Expertise: Deep proficiency in Python and hands-on experience designing and scaling modern APIs (e.g. FastAPI) in production, including async/await for I/O-bound workloads. Production experience with GraphQL (Strawberry or comparable) is a strong plus.
• AI Productization Experience: Hands-on experience integrating LLMs and AI APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) into production systems, with familiarity in RAG, agent frameworks, vector databases, MCP, or ML serving patterns.
• Data & Persistence: Strong production experience with PostgreSQL, SQLModel/SQLAlchemy, and Alembic, including schema design, indexing, and efficient queries.
• Cloud & DevOps: Solid working experience with Google Cloud Platform and/or Azure, Terraform, Docker, Git workflows, and CI/CD pipelines (Gitlab or equivalent).
• Quality & Collaboration: Strong testing discipline with pytest, a habit of writing maintainable, well-typed code, and the communication skills to mentor peers and partner closely with data scientists and AI engineers.
• Experience & Education: 5+ years in Backend Development, Software Engineering, or Systems Architecture, including significant experience designing and operating production systems. A relevant degree in Computer Science or related field is required. English fluency is required. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . AI Engineer

Madrid, Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7655

Join us in shaping the future of financial information. This is a high-leverage, player-coach role at the heart of how we scale AI delivery. You will set the technical direction for production-grade AI solutions. If you are passionate about agentic AI, enjoy solving hard engineering problems, and want to see your work used daily by real users in a critical products, this is a unique opportunity to have a tangible impact from day one.

What You Will Do

• Architect Multi-Agent Systems: Design, build, and orchestrate complex agentic workflows using LangGraph and LangChain to handle sophisticated financial queries and agents.

• Productize AI & GenAI Solutions: Build the backends, agent/RAG infrastructure, MCP servers, and LLM-serving layers that turn models, prompts, and pipelines into reliable, observable production products.

• Champion Quality & Coach Peers: Apply clean architecture and proven design patterns, enforce standards through tests and reviews, and coach junior engineers and rotating contributors.

• Implement Advanced RAG: Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems to ground model responses in proprietary data.

• Establish Evaluation Pipelines: Create rigorous testing frameworks and metrics to evaluate agent performance, reliability, and accuracy in a production environment.

What You Bring

• Core AI Engineering Stack: Deep expertise in Python and the modern AI stack, including LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI SDK, and Hugging Face Transformers. Strong ability to debug and optimize multi-agent workflows, with a focus on asynchronous execution, state management, and concurrency.

• API & Data Proficiency: Experience designing and integrating with complex REST/GraphQL endpoints and handling structured data formats (JSON/XML) for tool calling.

• Cloud & DevOps Mindset: Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) for deploying production-grade AI applications.

• Quality & Collaboration: Strong testing discipline with pytest, a habit of writing maintainable, well-typed code, and the communication skills to mentor peers and partner closely with data scientists and AI engineers.

• Experience & Education: 5+ years in software Engineering including significant experience in as a Gen AI Application Developer. A relevant degree in Computer Science or related field is required.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
