What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

DevOps Software Engineer (Gitlab)

Zurich | Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8112

Our centralized Software Development LifeCycle platform, based on GitLab and JFrog Artifactory, provides core capabilities to software developers across SIX. We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to maintain and evolve our GitLab platform and enhance our GitLab components with related tooling, that empower product teams across the organization to increase efficacy and code quality.

What You Will Do

• Take a leading role in maintaining and evolving our corporate SIX GitLab platform running in Azure

• Design, implement, and manage GitLab components and configurations (groups, projects, runners, pipelines, templates, shared libraries)

• Build and maintain shared CI/CD pipelines, reusable templates, automations and best-practice patterns for delivery at scale

• Implement and maintain GitLab Runners (Kubernetes, autoscaling, Docker, Shell) with enterprise-grade reliability and security

• Drive continuous improvement through automation, AI solutions, self-service capabilities and feedback loops

• Create documentation, runbooks, and internal enablement materials; deliver training and provide Tier 2/3 support for GitLab and related tools

What You Bring

• 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or SRE, with focus on GitLab administration and CI/CD. Experience with GitLab Premium or Ultimate features is a plus

• Proficiency with CI/CD concepts: branching strategies, pipeline as code, artifacts, environments, approvals, and compliance controls

• Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), deploying/scaling GitLab Runners on K8s, Prometheus and Grafana

• Familiarity with IaC tools (Terraform, Helm) and configuration management (Ansible or similar). Strong scripting and automation skills (Bash, Python or similar)

• Strong problem-solving skills, ownership mindset, and ability to work cross-functionally

• Team-player with good verbal and written skills in English

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 .

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Analisi dei dati

Varsavia | Fino al 40% di lavoro da casa possibile | Riferimento 8128

In qualità di Data Analyst, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel garantire l'accuratezza, la stabilità e l'affidabilità dei nostri processi di dati. Questa posizione è ideale per chi ama lavorare con set di dati complessi, collaborare con gli stakeholder e risolvere le sfide tecniche con una mentalità strutturata e analitica. Se siete motivati, curiosi e desiderosi di contribuire a operazioni di dati di alta qualità, questo ruolo offre una grande opportunità per crescere e fare un impatto.

Cosa farai

• eseguire onboarding tecnico dei fornitori di dati di fondo, tra cui l'analisi dei file, la configurazione di mappatura, test e distribuzione di produzione

• monitorare e gestire le consegne dei dati, assicurando il corretto trattamento e mantenendo le regole di invio della casella di posta

• coordinare con gli stakeholder per chiarire i requisiti e sostenere le attività di bordo e di funzionamento

• indagare e risolvere i dati, mappatura e problemi tecnici, escalation casi complessi quando richiesto

• monitorare l'elaborazione quotidiana e le eccezioni in DataHub, Xceptor e sistemi correlati per garantire la stabilità operativa

• mantenere i dati di qualità e di riferimento, tra cui mappature di classe di condivisione, classificazioni di asset e analisi di copertura

Che cosa porta

• laurea o diploma di istruzione superiore in finanza, economia o informatica e almeno 1 anno di esperienza lavorativa nei servizi finanziari

• buona conoscenza dei mercati finanziari e degli strumenti finanziari

• analitico, metodologico, tecnico, problem solving competenze sono una forza chiave

• motivato, inquisitivo e organizzato giocatore di squadra con uno spirito "può fare"

• eccellenti capacità verbali e scritte in inglese

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Agnieszka Leputa al numero +48 538 562 645

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Data Analyst

Warsaw | Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8128

As a Data Analyst , you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, stability, and reliability of our data processes. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with complex datasets, collaborating with stakeholders, and solving technical challenges with a structured, analytical mindset. If you’re motivated, curious, and eager to contribute to high‑quality data operations, this role offers a great opportunity to grow and make an impact.

What You Will Do

• perform technical onboarding of fund data providers, including file analysis, mapping configuration, testing, and production deployment

• monitor and manage data deliveries, ensuring successful processing and maintaining mailbox forwarding rules

• coordinate with stakeholders to clarify requirements and support onboarding and operational activities

• investigate and resolve data, mapping, and technical issues, escalating complex cases when required

• monitor daily processing and exceptions in DataHub, Xceptor, and related systems to ensure operational stability

• maintain data quality and reference data, including share class mappings, asset classifications, and coverage analysis

What You Bring

• bachelor’s or higher education degree in Finance, Economics or Computer Science and at least 1 year of working experience in financial services

• good knowledge of financial markets and securities instruments

• analytical, methodological, technical, problem-solving skills are a key strength

• motivated, inquisitive and organized team player with a "can do” spirit

• excellent verbal and written skills in English

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

descriptionByLocale.de:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Datenanalyst

Warschau | Bis zu 40% von zu Hause aus arbeiten möglich | Referenz 8128

Als Data Analyst spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gewährleistung der Genauigkeit, Stabilität und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Datenprozesse. Diese Position ist ideal für jemanden, der gerne mit komplexen Datensätzen arbeitet, mit Stakeholdern zusammenarbeitet und technische Herausforderungen mit einer strukturierten, analytischen Denkweise löst. Wenn Sie motiviert, neugierig und eifrig sind, zu qualitativ hochwertigen Datenoperationen beizutragen, bietet diese Rolle eine großartige Gelegenheit, zu wachsen und etwas zu bewirken.

Was Sie tun werden

• Führen Sie das technische Onboarding von Fondsdatenanbietern durch, einschließlich Dateianalyse, Zuordnungskonfiguration, Tests und Bereitstellung der Produktion

• Überwachung und Verwaltung der Datenlieferungen, Gewährleistung einer erfolgreichen Verarbeitung und Aufrechterhaltung der Regeln für die Postfachweiterleitung

• Koordination mit Stakeholdern zur Klärung von Anforderungen und Unterstützung von Onboarding und operativen Aktivitäten

• Untersuchung und Lösung von Daten, Mapping und technischen Problemen, bei Bedarf Eskalation komplexer Fälle

• Überwachung der täglichen Verarbeitung und Ausnahmen in DataHub, Xceptor und verwandten Systemen zur Gewährleistung der Betriebsstabilität

• Aufrechterhaltung der Datenqualität und Referenzdaten, einschließlich Share-Class-Mappings, Asset-Klassifizierungen und Coverage-Analysen

Was du mitbringst

• Bachelor- oder Hochschulabschluss in Finanzen, Wirtschaft oder Informatik und mindestens 1 Jahr Berufserfahrung in Finanzdienstleistungen

• gute Kenntnisse der Finanzmärkte und Wertpapierinstrumente

• analytische, methodische, technische, problemlösende Fähigkeiten sind eine Schlüsselstärke

• motivierter, neugieriger und organisierter Teamplayer mit einem "Can Do" -Geist

• ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Fähigkeiten in Englisch

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Agnieszka Leputa unter +48 538 562 645 an

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Analyste des données

Varsovie: jusqu'à 40% de travail à domicile possible

En tant qu'analyste de données, vous jouerez un rôle clé pour assurer la précision, la stabilité et la fiabilité de nos processus de données. Cette position est idéale pour quelqu'un qui aime travailler avec des ensembles de données complexes, collaborer avec les intervenants et résoudre les défis techniques avec un état d'esprit structuré et analytique. Si vous êtes motivé, curieux et désireux de contribuer à des opérations de données de haute qualité, ce rôle offre une excellente occasion de grandir et d'avoir un impact.

Ce que vous ferez

• effectuer l'embarquement technique des fournisseurs de données du fonds, y compris l'analyse des fichiers, la configuration des cartes, les essais et le déploiement de la production

• surveiller et gérer les livraisons de données, assurer le traitement efficace et maintenir les règles de transmission des boîtes aux lettres

• coordonner avec les parties prenantes pour clarifier les exigences et l'appui aux activités de bord et opérationnelles

• enquêter sur les données, la cartographie et les problèmes techniques et les résoudre, en augmentant les cas complexes au besoin

• surveiller le traitement quotidien et les exceptions dans DataHub, Xceptor et les systèmes connexes pour assurer la stabilité opérationnelle

• maintenir la qualité des données et les données de référence, y compris la cartographie des classes de parts, la classification des actifs et l'analyse de la couverture;

Ce que vous apportez

• Licence ou diplôme d'études supérieures en finance, économie ou informatique et au moins 1 an d'expérience dans les services financiers

• bonne connaissance des marchés financiers et des instruments de valeurs mobilières

• Les compétences analytiques, méthodologiques, techniques et en résolution de problèmes constituent une force clé

• motivé, curieux et organisé joueur d'équipe avec un "peut faire" esprit

• excellentes compétences verbales et écrites en anglais

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Agnieszka Leputa au +48 538 562 645

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

• Strong experience in technical writing, document lifecycle management, and structured content creation.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Lead Data Platform Engineer (Databricks) Madrid, Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7582 Join SIX Financial Information's AI Engineering team as the Lead Data Platform Engineer of our Data Platform & Analytics squad. You will own the roadmap and evolution of our Data Science Platform on Azure and Databricks the self-service foundation that data scientists, analysts, business analysts, and AI engineers across the organization rely on to turn complex financial data into production-ready insights. This is a player-coach leadership role with direct line management responsibility for a small squad. You will remain close to the code, set technical direction for the platform, partner closely with the rest of the team to productionize what we build while partnering with other technical and business stakeholders. What You Will Do
• Own the Data Science Platform Roadmap: Define and drive the technical strategy for the DSP on Azure Databricks, balancing platform stability, self-service capabilities, and the evolving needs of data scientists and AI engineers.
• Productize Analytics Solutions: Lead the productization of the advanced dashboarding and analytics data products, turning prototypes into reliable, well-governed, scalable data products that can be reliably consumed by end users.
• Build Self-Service Foundations: Design and operate the lakehouse architecture, data pipelines and curated models, and governance patterns (Unity Catalog, dbt, access controls) that enable analysts and scientists to work autonomously on financial data.
• Lead and Grow the Squad: Line manage and and mentor a small team of data platform engineers, set engineering standards, review design and code, and coordinate with rotating contributors to deliver against the roadmap.
• Partner Across Teams: Collaborate closely with the MLOps / Platform Engineering team on CI/CD and observability, with the AI Solutions and Productization squads on data needs, and with business stakeholders to align the platform with real analytics and self-service use cases. What You Bring
• Technical Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, dbt, SQL, and Python. Solid command of lakehouse architectures, data modeling, analytics engineering practices and production-grade data pipelines.
• Platform Mindset: Proven experience designing and operating data platforms in enterprise or regulated environments, including Unity Catalog governance and cost/performance optimization.
• Player-coach Leadership: Experience leading or mentoring a small technical team while staying hands-on in architecture, implementation, code reviews, and production delivery.
• Productization & Self-Service: Experience taking analytics or data products from prototype to production and enabling self-service consumption by non-platform teams (data scientists, analysts, business users).
• Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with financial data structures and the demands of data-driven systems in complex, regulated organizations is highly desirable.
• Experience & Education: 5+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data platform roles. Relevant degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; Azure or Databricks certifications are a strong plus. English fluency is required. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Lead Data Platform Engineer (Databricks)

Madrid, Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7582

Join SIX Financial Information's AI Engineering team as the Lead Data Platform Engineer of our Data Platform & Analytics squad. You will own the roadmap and evolution of our Data Science Platform on Azure and Databricks the self-service foundation that data scientists, analysts, business analysts, and AI engineers across the organization rely on to turn complex financial data into production-ready insights.

This is a player-coach leadership role with direct line management responsibility for a small squad. You will remain close to the code, set technical direction for the platform, partner closely with the rest of the team to productionize what we build while partnering with other technical and business stakeholders.

What You Will Do

• Own the Data Science Platform Roadmap: Define and drive the technical strategy for the DSP on Azure Databricks, balancing platform stability, self-service capabilities, and the evolving needs of data scientists and AI engineers.

• Productize Analytics Solutions: Lead the productization of the advanced dashboarding and analytics data products, turning prototypes into reliable, well-governed, scalable data products that can be reliably consumed by end users.

• Build Self-Service Foundations: Design and operate the lakehouse architecture, data pipelines and curated models, and governance patterns (Unity Catalog, dbt, access controls) that enable analysts and scientists to work autonomously on financial data.

• Lead and Grow the Squad: Line manage and and mentor a small team of data platform engineers, set engineering standards, review design and code, and coordinate with rotating contributors to deliver against the roadmap.

• Partner Across Teams: Collaborate closely with the MLOps / Platform Engineering team on CI/CD and observability, with the AI Solutions and Productization squads on data needs, and with business stakeholders to align the platform with real analytics and self-service use cases.

What You Bring

• Technical Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, dbt, SQL, and Python. Solid command of lakehouse architectures, data modeling, analytics engineering practices and production-grade data pipelines.

• Platform Mindset: Proven experience designing and operating data platforms in enterprise or regulated environments, including Unity Catalog governance and cost/performance optimization.

• Player-coach Leadership: Experience leading or mentoring a small technical team while staying hands-on in architecture, implementation, code reviews, and production delivery.

• Productization & Self-Service: Experience taking analytics or data products from prototype to production and enabling self-service consumption by non-platform teams (data scientists, analysts, business users).

• Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with financial data structures and the demands of data-driven systems in complex, regulated organizations is highly desirable.

• Experience & Education: 5+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data platform roles. Relevant degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; Azure or Databricks certifications are a strong plus. English fluency is required.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Sviluppatore & Integration Specialist

Varsavia | lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8150

Vuoi lavorare in un ambiente cloud SAP moderno e crescere la tua esperienza di integrazione? Cerchiamo un SAP Sviluppatore e Integrazione per unire il nostro team CIT-ACI / Innovation & Technology di Varsavia, responsabile delle integrazioni edilizie, supportando le applicazioni SAP BTP e contribuendo a soluzioni basate su Fiori. Partecipa a un team che valorizza collaborazione, proprietà, innovazione.

Cosa farai

• Costruire, monitorare e mantenere integrazioni utilizzando gli strumenti SAP Integration Suite e Cloud Integration nei paesaggi aziendali

• Supporta lo sviluppo e la manutenzione di applicazioni e estensioni su SAP Business Technology Platform

• Contribuisci alle applicazioni Fiori e SAPUI5 con test, risoluzione dei problemi e miglioramenti incrementali delle funzionalità

• Collabora con architetti e sviluppatori senior per progettare soluzioni SAP scalabili, sicure e manutenbili

• Supporta l'analisi degli incidenti, la documentazione e le attività di rilascio attraverso API, interfacce e servizi cloud

Che cosa porta

• Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria o simili, con solida comprensione dei fondamenti di sviluppo software

• Conoscenza di base o forte interesse per SAP BTP, Integration Suite, Fiori o SAPUI5 tecnologie e concetti

• Comprensione di API, servizi REST, JSON e XML per scenari di integrazione in sistemi SAP e non SAP

• Fondamenti di programmazione in JavaScript, Java, Node.js o lingue simili, con problemi analitici risolvere mindset

• Forte capacità di comunicazione in inglese, con approccio strutturato e proattivo al lavoro di squadra e all'apprendimento

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Julia Schmidt al numero +41 583 994 236 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Developer & Integration Specialist

Warsaw | working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8150

Do you want to work in a modern SAP cloud environment and grow your integration expertise? We seek a SAP Developer and Integration to join our CIT-ACI / Innovation & Technology team in Warsaw, responsible for building integrations, supporting SAP BTP applications, and contributing to Fiori-based solutions. Be part of a team that values collaboration, ownership, innovation.

What You Will Do

• Build, monitor and maintain integrations using SAP Integration Suite and Cloud Integration tools in enterprise landscapes

• Support the development and maintenance of applications and extensions on SAP Business Technology Platform

• Contribute to Fiori and SAPUI5 apps with testing, troubleshooting and incremental feature enhancements

• Collaborate with architects and senior developers to design scalable, secure and maintainable SAP solutions

• Support incident analysis, documentation and release activities across APIs, interfaces and cloud services

What You Bring

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or similar, with solid understanding of software development fundamentals

• Basic knowledge or strong interest in SAP BTP, Integration Suite, Fiori or SAPUI5 technologies and concepts

• Understanding of APIs, REST services, JSON and XML for integration scenarios across SAP and non SAP systems

• Programming basics in JavaScript, Java, Node.js or similar languages, with analytical problem solving mindset

• Strong communication skills in English, with structured and proactive approach to teamwork and learning

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt at +41 583 994 236 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
descriptionByLocale.de:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Entwickler & Integration Spezialist

Warschau | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% möglich | Referenz 8150

Sie möchten in einer modernen SAP-Cloud-Umgebung arbeiten und Ihre Integrationskompetenz ausbauen? Wir suchen einen SAP-Entwickler und -Integration für unser CIT-ACI / Innovation & Technology-Team in Warschau, das für den Aufbau von Integrationen, die Unterstützung von SAP-BTP-Anwendungen und den Beitrag zu Fiori-basierten Lösungen verantwortlich ist. Werden Sie Teil eines Teams, das Zusammenarbeit, Eigentum und Innovation schätzt.

Was Sie tun werden

• Erstellen, Überwachen und Pflegen von Integrationen mit SAP Integration Suite und Cloud Integration Tools in Unternehmenslandschaften

• Unterstützung der Entwicklung und Wartung von Anwendungen und Erweiterungen auf der SAP Business Technology Platform

• Tragen Sie zu Fiori- und SAPUI5-Apps bei, indem Sie Tests, Fehlersuche und inkrementelle Funktionserweiterungen durchführen

• Arbeiten Sie mit Architekten und leitenden Entwicklern zusammen, um skalierbare, sichere und wartbare SAP-Lösungen zu entwerfen

• Unterstützung von Incident-Analyse, Dokumentation und Release-Aktivitäten über APIs, Schnittstellen und Cloud-Services hinweg

Was du mitbringst

• Abschluss in Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder ähnlichem, mit einem soliden Verständnis der Grundlagen der Softwareentwicklung

• Grundkenntnisse oder starkes Interesse an SAP BTP, Integration Suite, Fiori oder SAPUI5 Technologien und Konzepten

• Verständnis von APIs, REST-Services, JSON und XML für Integrationsszenarien in SAP- und Nicht-SAP-Systemen

• Programmiergrundlagen in JavaScript, Java, Node.js oder ähnlichen Sprachen, mit analytischer Problemlösung

• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch mit strukturiertem und proaktivem Ansatz für Teamarbeit und Lernen

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Julia Schmidt unter +41 583 994 236 an.

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre racines locales et pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Développeur & Spécialiste de l'intégration

Varsovie: travailler à partir de la maison jusqu'à 40% possible

Voulez-vous travailler dans un environnement cloud SAP moderne et développer votre expertise d'intégration? Nous recherchons un développeur et intégration SAP pour rejoindre notre équipe CIT-ICI / Innovation & Technologie à Varsovie, responsable de la construction d'intégrations, supportant les applications SAP BTP et contribuant aux solutions basées sur Fiori. Faites partie d'une équipe qui valorise la collaboration, la propriété, l'innovation.

Ce que vous ferez

• Construire, surveiller et maintenir les intégrations en utilisant SAP Integration Suite et les outils d'intégration Cloud dans les paysages d'entreprise

• Soutenir le développement et la maintenance des applications et extensions sur SAP Business Technology Platform

• Contribuer aux applications Fiori et SAPUI5 avec tests, dépannage et améliorations progressives des fonctionnalités

• Collaborer avec les architectes et les développeurs seniors pour concevoir des solutions SAP évolutives, sécurisées et durables

• Soutenir les activités d'analyse des incidents, de documentation et de diffusion dans les API, les interfaces et les services cloud

Ce que vous apportez

• Diplôme en informatique, génie ou similaire, avec une bonne compréhension des fondamentaux de développement de logiciels

• Connaissances de base ou fort intérêt pour les technologies et concepts SAP BTP, Integration Suite, Fiori ou SAPUI5

• Compréhension des API, des services REST, JSON et XML pour les scénarios d'intégration dans les systèmes SAP et non SAP

• Programmation de base en langages JavaScript, Java, Node.js ou similaires, avec résolution analytique de problèmes

• Fortes compétences en communication en anglais, avec une approche structurée et proactive du travail d'équipe et de l'apprentissage

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Julia Schmidt au +41 583 994 236 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

QA & Testing Governance Lead Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7940 If you have strong experience in QA and Test Management, combined with a structured mindset and the ability to align diverse teams around common standards, we would welcome you to join us as QA & Testing Governance Lead within Securities Services IT at SIX. This role is part of the Program & Service Management function and is responsible for defining and driving common QA and testing governance, standards, and best practices across Securities Services IT. While Test Managers and testing roles are embedded in the different vertical areas, this position ensures a shared “common ground” and consistent quality governance across the organization. Depending on needs and priorities, the role may also include acting as Test Manager in selected projects within the vertical areas, combining strategic governance responsibilities with hands on delivery involvement. Does it sound interesting to you? We are looking forward to meeting you. Apply now with your CV in English! What You Will Do
• Define, maintain and evolve QA and Testing governance, standards and best practices for Securities Services IT, with a strong focus on enabling shift‑left quality practices in close collaboration with engineering teams.
• Establish and maintain a common reference model for test phases, entry/exit criteria, go live quality gates and production readiness expectations.
• Act as the central coordination point for Test Management practices, fostering alignment and reuse of proven approaches across the different vertical areas.
• Define and standardize quality metrics, KPIs and reporting, enabling transparency, comparability and data driven decision making.
• Drive alignment of testing and test automation practices and tooling, favoring enablement models (e.g. shared baselines, self‑service approaches) over purely top‑down enforcement, while balancing standardization with context‑specific needs.
• Contribute, when required, as Test Manager in concrete initiatives or projects, supporting test planning, defect governance and go live readiness. What You Bring
• 7+ years of hands‑on experience in QA, Test Management or Quality Governance in complex IT environments (regulated or mission‑critical contexts are a strong advantage).
• Proven experience defining and rolling out standards, governance models, processes and metrics across multiple teams or units.
• Strong understanding of test phases, testing strategies, entry/exit criteria, defect management and production readiness.
• Solid knowledge of test management and defect tracking tools and evidence‑based quality reporting, including metrics that help connect quality outcomes with delivery performance.
• Location in Spain, with willingness to travel occasionally to Switzerland.
• Fluent English (mandatory); Spanish highly valued; German a plus. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 . Head Clearing Product & Business Development Madrid, London, Zurich | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7862 SIX Securities Services operates the processes downstream of securities trading including clearing, settlement, custody, securities finance and trade reporting. As part of SIX Securities Services, SIX Clearing plays a key role in the European post-trade value chain, offering highly diversified CCP clearing across several asset classes and services with access to multiple trading platforms across Europe. Operating out of Madrid, Zurich and Oslo, SIX Clearing has a truly pan-European footprint. As Head of Product & Business Development – Clearing you will be responsible for the end-to-end product and growth agenda of SIX’s clearing services across multiple asset classes. You will lead two specialised teams—Product Management and Business Development—each headed by an experienced team lead. In this senior role, you shape clearing strategy, drive growth initiatives, ensure product competitiveness, and act as a key interface to clients, trading venues, regulators, and internal stakeholders. You are a member of the Clearing Management Committee and contribute directly to the strategic direction of the clearing business. What You Will Do
• Lead Product Management and Business Development for all clearing products across five asset classes, managing two team leaders and overall team performance.
• Define and execute the clearing product strategy and roadmap, ensuring competitiveness in terms of coverage, connectivity, pricing, and service levels. Identify and drive growth opportunities, including new market segments, trading venue connections, partnerships, and interoperability initiatives, with ownership of business cases and regulatory processes.
• Act as senior business interface and escalation point for strategic clearing members, trading venues, and key partners, closely aligned with the Executive Team and Sales.
• Represent Clearing at senior internal and external forums, including the Clearing Management Committee, regulatory and industry working groups, and selected client events. What You Bring
• University degree in economics, finance, business, engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
• Extensive experience in post-trade financial market infrastructure, clearing, exchanges, or related financial services. As a clearing expert you fundamentally understand the industry and product mechanisms of Liquidity, Collateral, Balance Sheet Optimisation and Margin across different asset classes.
• You naturally build senior strategic relationships both internally and externally, translating ideas into roadmaps and operational execution. Track record of fostering strong commercial relationships with customers, partners and suppliers.
• Strong strategic, analytical, and commercial mindset, with experience owning product strategies, business cases, and growth initiatives.
• An entrepreneurial nature with an intuitive understanding of how to create value in a highly competitive business. A thought leader with a strong affinity for continuous innovation and an ability to synthesise customer sentiment, competitor initiatives and trends in both direct and adjacent markets, in order to stay ahead of - and ideally, harness - industry disruption
• Proven people-leadership skills, including managing senior professionals and team leads in a complex, cross-functional, international environment and excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills at senior management, client, and regulatory level.
• Excellent oral and written English skills; German and/or Spanish is an advantage. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Clearing Product & Business Development

Madrid, London, Zurich | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7862

SIX Securities Services operates the processes downstream of securities trading including clearing, settlement, custody, securities finance and trade reporting. As part of SIX Securities Services, SIX Clearing plays a key role in the European post-trade value chain, offering highly diversified CCP clearing across several asset classes and services with access to multiple trading platforms across Europe. Operating out of Madrid, Zurich and Oslo, SIX Clearing has a truly pan-European footprint.

As Head of Product & Business Development – Clearing you will be responsible for the end-to-end product and growth agenda of SIX’s clearing services across multiple asset classes. You will lead two specialised teams—Product Management and Business Development—each headed by an experienced team lead. In this senior role, you shape clearing strategy, drive growth initiatives, ensure product competitiveness, and act as a key interface to clients, trading venues, regulators, and internal stakeholders. You are a member of the Clearing Management Committee and contribute directly to the strategic direction of the clearing business.

What You Will Do

• Lead Product Management and Business Development for all clearing products across five asset classes, managing two team leaders and overall team performance.

• Define and execute the clearing product strategy and roadmap, ensuring competitiveness in terms of coverage, connectivity, pricing, and service levels.
Identify and drive growth opportunities, including new market segments, trading venue connections, partnerships, and interoperability initiatives, with ownership of business cases and regulatory processes.

• Act as senior business interface and escalation point for strategic clearing members, trading venues, and key partners, closely aligned with the Executive Team and Sales.

• Represent Clearing at senior internal and external forums, including the Clearing Management Committee, regulatory and industry working groups, and selected client events.

What You Bring

• University degree in economics, finance, business, engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.

• Extensive experience in post-trade financial market infrastructure, clearing, exchanges, or related financial services. As a clearing expert you fundamentally understand the industry and product mechanisms of Liquidity, Collateral, Balance Sheet Optimisation and Margin across different asset classes.

• You naturally build senior strategic relationships both internally and externally, translating ideas into roadmaps and operational execution. Track record of fostering strong commercial relationships with customers, partners and suppliers.

• Strong strategic, analytical, and commercial mindset, with experience owning product strategies, business cases, and growth initiatives.

• An entrepreneurial nature with an intuitive understanding of how to create value in a highly competitive business. A thought leader with a strong affinity for continuous innovation and an ability to synthesise customer sentiment, competitor initiatives and trends in both direct and adjacent markets, in order to stay ahead of - and ideally, harness - industry disruption

• Proven people-leadership skills, including managing senior professionals and team leads in a complex, cross-functional, international environment and excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills at senior management, client, and regulatory level.

• Excellent oral and written English skills; German and/or Spanish is an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Senior Data Architect Warsaw | working from home up to 40% | Reference 7637 The Financial Information division within SIX Group is a global provider of financial data and analytics to the global financial services industry. This role sits within the Business-led Product Development division and focuses on business data architecture, ensuring our financial data products meet customer, commercial and regulatory needs. The role partners closely with IT Architecture as a key stakeholder but is not part of the IT function. We are looking for an experienced data architect to work within the Financial Information Product Delivery group to provide data architecture leadership across the firm to ensure our data products deliver value to our customers and they can be readily maintained and enhanced. This encompasses the design and architecture of logical and physical data models and schemas, data transport mechanisms, metadata management, lineage management, API schema design and enabling SIX financial information to be accessible to AI agents. What You Will Do
• Design, develop and maintain the technology-agnostic, business-aligned canonical/conceptual data models for Financial Information, defining class definitions, standards and association semantics.
• Provide data architecture expertise to all delivery teams to ensure we build data products that meet customer expectations, can be readily maintained and enhanced, and we have a core foundation on which we can readily build new revenue generating products.
• Develop and maintain design, naming conventions, dictionaries, lineage and metadata standards, collaborating with data quality teams to ensure models support validation rules.
• Partner with stakeholders across the business to translate complex data concepts and requirements into robust data products that customers want to purchase whilst contributing to the architectural governance process.
• Support the evolution of data distribution models, including API-first delivery and AI data access enablement. What You Bring
• Hands-on experience designing schemas for relational databases, messaging, data lakes/lakehouses (Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent), and API/message formats (JSON Schema, OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf). Strong understanding of metadata and lineage management.
• 5+ years of experience, or demonstrated delivery against requirements in data modelling, data architecture, or a closely related discipline within financial services with proficiency in UML data modelling tools such as Sparx EA (ideally), Erwin, PowerDesigner or similar
• Strong understanding of the financial data domain: securities reference data, corporate actions, market data, and regulatory classifications, fixed income would be highly desirable
• Understanding of API design principles (REST, GraphQL) and schema evolution strategies for backward compatibility is essential. Direct experience of making data commercially available to AI agents is desirable.
• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German is a plus. It is essential that the person in this role is able to clearly communicate complex concepts and data structures to a wide range of stakeholders. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <div dir="auto" style=" " class="buttontext buttontextc3db959e6bb5c100

Senior Data Architect

Warsaw | working from home up to 40% | Reference 7637

The Financial Information division within SIX Group is a global provider of financial data and analytics to the global financial services industry. This role sits within the Business-led Product Development division and focuses on business data architecture, ensuring our financial data products meet customer, commercial and regulatory needs. The role partners closely with IT Architecture as a key stakeholder but is not part of the IT function.

We are looking for an experienced data architect to work within the Financial Information Product Delivery group to provide data architecture leadership across the firm to ensure our data products deliver value to our customers and they can be readily maintained and enhanced. This encompasses the design and architecture of logical and physical data models and schemas, data transport mechanisms, metadata management, lineage management, API schema design and enabling SIX financial information to be accessible to AI agents.

What You Will Do

• Design, develop and maintain the technology-agnostic, business-aligned canonical/conceptual data models for Financial Information, defining class definitions, standards and association semantics.
• Provide data architecture expertise to all delivery teams to ensure we build data products that meet customer expectations, can be readily maintained and enhanced, and we have a core foundation on which we can readily build new revenue generating products.
• Develop and maintain design, naming conventions, dictionaries, lineage and metadata standards, collaborating with data quality teams to ensure models support validation rules.
• Partner with stakeholders across the business to translate complex data concepts and requirements into robust data products that customers want to purchase whilst contributing to the architectural governance process.
• Support the evolution of data distribution models, including API-first delivery and AI data access enablement.

What You Bring

• Hands-on experience designing schemas for relational databases, messaging, data lakes/lakehouses (Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent), and API/message formats (JSON Schema, OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf). Strong understanding of metadata and lineage management.
• 5+ years of experience, or demonstrated delivery against requirements in data modelling, data architecture, or a closely related discipline within financial services with proficiency in UML data modelling tools such as Sparx EA (ideally), Erwin, PowerDesigner or similar
• Strong understanding of the financial data domain: securities reference data, corporate actions, market data, and regulatory classifications, fixed income would be highly desirable
• Understanding of API design principles (REST, GraphQL) and schema evolution strategies for backward compatibility is essential. Direct experience of making data commercially available to AI agents is desirable.
• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German is a plus. It is essential that the person in this role is able to clearly communicate complex concepts and data structures to a wide range of stakeholders.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Join our RegTech team in a hybrid role between Product, Engineering, Operations, Support and Clients. Our RegTech SaaS solutions support financial institutions with Transaction Cost Analysis, Best Execution and Trade Surveillance. As AI-augmented delivery increases change velocity, we need strong operational product ownership to ensure resilience, monitoring, security, onboarding efficiency and client delivery improve systematically - not ad hoc. What You Will Do
• Own and prioritize the backlog for platform operations, monitoring, resilience, onboarding tooling and technical client delivery.
• Translate incidents, support cases, client requests and due-diligence questions into structural improvements.
• Work with Engineering and Platform teams to improve observability, maintainability, automation an operational robustness.
• Support RFPs, DORA/security questionnaires and technical discussions with clients.
• Define requirements for internal tools that reduce manual effort and key-person dependency.
• Bridge Product, Support, Engineering, Sales and Clients with clear priorities and practical execution.
• Level 2 support for complex technical issues and help translate recurring incidents, onboarding frictions and reliability concerns into better monitoring, testing, documentation and platform improvements. What You Bring
• Strong technical reasoning across Linux, logs, SQL, APIs, data flows and production systems.
• Experience owning backlogs, writing clear requirements and prioritizing across competing needs.
• Client-facing credibility on technical, operational or regulatory topics.
• Ability to spot patterns in operational work and convert them into scalable solutions.
• Structured communication, pragmatic judgment and a bias for repeatability and simplification.
• Very good English; Spanish, German or French are an advantage. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . SIX sta guidando la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge a progredire: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Valorizziamo le menti intelligenti e le ispiriamo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro dei mercati finanziari con noi.

Studente di lavoro SIC Operazioni 60-70

Zurigo, 60-70, riferimento 8012

Volete acquisire la prima esperienza professionale e dare un importante contributo alla qualità del centro finanziario svizzero? Siete un allrounder/amministrativo? Allora siamo felici di sentirvi! Supportate le operazioni SIC nei suoi compiti amministrativi, tra cui il monitoraggio e l'esecuzione di processi di scambio chiave, in modo che i nostri partecipanti possano anche testare e lavorare senza interruzioni durante le fasi di migrazione. Potete anche lavorare in progetti, eseguire statistiche e valutazioni e sono dove è necessario il supporto.

Come azienda moderna, dinamica e innovativa, offriamo una varietà di opportunità per sbloccare il tuo potenziale nel mondo emozionante della tecnologia e della finanza. Ti sosteniamo nel tuo ingresso nella carriera, investi nel tuo sviluppo e amplia le tue competenze personali. Come "Studente di lavoro" fino a quando non fai parte della nostra comunità NextGen e fai parte di una rete di starter dedicati alla carriera.

Questi sono i tuoi compiti

- Condotta di processi di scambio chiave per garantire canali di comunicazione sicuri - Gestione e manutenzione dei dati master dei partecipanti - Trattamento dei moduli (online, PDF) incluso l'esame delle forme di partecipazione in entrata - Adeguamenti dei siti web e del punto di condivisione SIC - Assistenza amministrativa generale nel team

Porta questo con te

- Studi attuali preferibilmente in ambito economico - Comprensione tecnica o alto vantaggio di efficienza IT-A - Alto grado di lavoro autonomo e disponibilità - Giocatore di squadra con molto piacere nel contatto con i clienti - Conoscenza espressa dell'ufficio MS (Word, Excel, Visio ecc.) - Ottima conoscenza della lingua tedesca e inglese in termini di parole e scrittura, il francese è un plus - residenziale in Svizzera (a causa dell'accesso ai sistemi produttivi)

Offriamo

- Supporto per l'avviamento della tua carriera - Investimento nel tuo sviluppo e nell'espansione delle tue competenze personali - Parte di una rete di starter dedicati

Contatto

Per qualsiasi domanda, visita la nostra pagina FAQ o contatta Janine Reichling al +41 58 399 42 99.

Per questa vacanza si tiene conto solo delle domande dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi, quindi siamo felici delle applicazioni indipendentemente dal background personale.

- Conduct of key exchange processes to ensure secure communication channels - Management and maintenance of participant master data - Processing of forms (online, PDF) including examination of incoming forms of participants - Adjustments of websites and SIC sharepoint - General administrative support in the team

You bring this with you

- Current studies preferably in the economic environment - Technical understanding or high IT-A efficiency advantage - High degree of self-employment and helpfulness - Team player with a lot of pleasure in customer contact - Expressed MS Office knowledge (Word, Excel, Visio etc.) - Very good German and English knowledge in word and writing, French is a plus - residential in Switzerland (due to access to productive systems)

- Support for your career starter - Investment in your development and the expansion of your personal skills - Part of a network of dedicated career starters

SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Ingegnere di software senior

Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8108

Vuoi costruire e gestire sistemi affidabili e scalabili che alimentano servizi indici finanziari? Sei appassionato di ingegneria hands-on durante la consegna leader in un team distribuito?

Il nostro team Index ha sede a Zurigo e in India e sviluppa piattaforme principali che permettono la creazione, il calcolo e la distribuzione di indici finanziari. Lavoriamo all'incrocio tra dati, ingegneria e mercati finanziari, garantendo servizi stabili e di alta qualità per gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.

Come Ingegnere di software senior, assumerai un ruolo tecnico leader all'interno di questa configurazione distribuita, lavorando a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri in India. Mentre questo non è un ruolo di gestione delle persone, guiderà il team da una prospettiva tecnica e di consegna, assicurando che gli impegni sono soddisfatti di alta qualità e in tempo. Potrai combinare una forte ingegneria hands-on con una chiara proprietà, collaborando a stretto contatto con product manager, esperti di dominio e team SRE per costruire soluzioni affidabili ed efficaci.

Cosa farai

• Progettazione, costruzione e manutenzione di servizi backend utilizzando Java (Spring Boot) e Python per le piattaforme di calcolo e elaborazione dati indici

• Proprio la consegna end-to-end di caratteristiche, assicurandosi che vengano consegnati in tempo e soddisfare le aspettative di qualità

• Guidare la consegna tecnica di un team di ingegneria distribuito in India, allineare il team e garantire risultati coerenti e di alta qualità (senza gestione diretta della linea)

• Collaborare con i team SRE per garantire che i sistemi siano affidabili e pronti alla produzione, contribuendo a miglioramenti laddove necessario

• Guidare le decisioni di architettura e ingegneria per migliorare la scalabilità, le prestazioni e la manutenbilità

Che cosa porta

• Forte esperienza di ingegneria del software pratico con Java (Spring Boot) e Python in un ambiente di produzione

• Esperienza di consegna leader in una configurazione distribuita, con un focus su responsabilità e risultati

• Solida comprensione della progettazione del sistema backend e dei sistemi distribuiti

• Esperienza utilizzando moderni strumenti di ingegneria e sviluppo assistita da AI per migliorare la produttività e la qualità del codice

• Corso di laurea o Master in Informatica o un campo correlato, o equivalente esperienza hands-on nei sistemi di produzione di costruzione e operativi

• Capacità di comunicazione fluente inglese; tedesco è un plus

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Mateusz Kozielec al numero +41583998611 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Software Engineer

Zurich | Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8108

Do you want to build and operate reliable, scalable systems powering financial index services? Are you passionate about hands-on engineering while leading delivery in a distributed team?

Our Index team is based in Zurich and India and develops core platforms that enable the creation, calculation, and distribution of financial indices. We work at the intersection of data, engineering, and financial markets, ensuring stable and high-quality services for internal and external stakeholders.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will take a leading technical role within this distributed setup, working closely with engineers in India. While this is not a people management role, you will lead the team from a technical and delivery perspective, ensuring that commitments are met with high quality and on time. You will combine strong hands-on engineering with clear ownership, collaborating closely with product managers, domain experts, and SRE teams to build reliable and effective solutions.

What You Will Do

• Design, build, and maintain backend services using Java (Spring Boot) and Python for index calculation and data processing platforms

• Own the end-to-end delivery of features, ensuring they are delivered on time and meet quality expectations

• Lead the technical delivery of a distributed engineering team in India, aligning the team and ensuring consistent, high-quality outcomes (without direct line management)

• Collaborate with SRE teams to ensure systems are reliable and production-ready, contributing to improvements where needed

• Drive architecture and engineering decisions to improve scalability, performance, and maintainability

What You Bring

• Strong hands-on software engineering experience with Java (Spring Boot) and Python in a production environment

• Experience leading delivery in a distributed setup, with a focus on accountability and outcomes

• Solid understanding of backend system design and distributed systems

• Experience using modern engineering tooling and AI-assisted development to improve productivity and code quality

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience in building and operating production systems

• Fluent English communication skills; German is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Senior Software Engineer

Zürich | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% möglich | Referenz 8108

Möchten Sie zuverlässige, skalierbare Systeme für Finanzindexdienste aufbauen und betreiben? Haben Sie eine Leidenschaft für praktisches Engineering, während Sie die Lieferung in einem verteilten Team leiten?

Unser Index-Team hat seinen Sitz in Zürich und Indien und entwickelt Kernplattformen, die die Erstellung, Berechnung und Verteilung von Finanzindizes ermöglichen. Wir arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von Daten-, Engineering- und Finanzmärkten und gewährleisten stabile und qualitativ hochwertige Dienstleistungen für interne und externe Stakeholder.

Als Senior Software Engineer übernehmen Sie eine führende technische Rolle in diesem verteilten Setup und arbeiten eng mit Ingenieuren in Indien zusammen. Obwohl dies keine Rolle des Personalmanagements ist, werden Sie das Team aus technischer und Lieferperspektive führen und sicherstellen, dass die Verpflichtungen mit hoher Qualität und pünktlich erfüllt werden. Sie kombinieren starkes Hands-on-Engineering mit klarem Eigentum und arbeiten eng mit Produktmanagern, Domänenexperten und SRE-Teams zusammen, um zuverlässige und effektive Lösungen zu entwickeln.

Was Sie tun werden

• Design, Build und Wartung von Backend-Services mit Java (Spring Boot) und Python für Indexberechnungs- und Datenverarbeitungsplattformen

• Besitzen Sie die End-to-End-Lieferung von Funktionen, um sicherzustellen, dass sie pünktlich geliefert werden und die Qualitätserwartungen erfüllen

• Führen Sie die technische Lieferung eines verteilten Ingenieurteams in Indien, richten Sie das Team aus und gewährleisten Sie konsistente, qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse (ohne direktes Linienmanagement)

• Arbeiten Sie mit SRE-Teams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Systeme zuverlässig und produktionsfähig sind und bei Bedarf zu Verbesserungen beitragen

• Treiber von Architektur- und Engineering-Entscheidungen zur Verbesserung von Skalierbarkeit, Leistung und Wartbarkeit

Was du mitbringst

• Starke praktische Erfahrung mit Java (Spring Boot) und Python in einer Produktionsumgebung

• Führende Lieferung in einem verteilten Setup mit Fokus auf Rechenschaftspflicht und Ergebnisse

• Solides Verständnis von Backend-Systemdesign und verteilten Systemen

• Erfahrung mit modernen Engineering-Tools und KI-gestützter Entwicklung zur Verbesserung der Produktivität und Codequalität

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von Produktionssystemen

• Fließende Englischkenntnisse; Deutsch ist ein Plus

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Mateusz Kozielec unter +41583998611 an.

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

Ingénieur logiciel principal

Zurich: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% possible

Voulez-vous construire et utiliser des systèmes fiables et évolutifs qui alimentent les services d'indice financier? Êtes-vous passionné par l'ingénierie pratique tout en menant la livraison dans une équipe distribuée?

Notre équipe Index est basée à Zurich et en Inde et développe des plateformes de base qui permettent la création, le calcul et la distribution d'indices financiers. Nous travaillons à l'intersection des données, de l'ingénierie et des marchés financiers, assurant des services stables et de qualité pour les intervenants internes et externes.

En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel senior, vous jouerez un rôle technique de premier plan dans cette configuration distribuée, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs en Inde. Bien qu'il ne s'agisse pas d'un rôle de gestion des personnes, vous dirigerez l'équipe du point de vue technique et de la prestation, en veillant à ce que les engagements soient respectés avec une grande qualité et à temps. Vous combinerez une forte ingénierie pratique avec une appropriation claire, en collaborant étroitement avec les gestionnaires de produits, les experts de domaine et les équipes SRE pour construire des solutions fiables et efficaces.

Ce que vous ferez

• Concevoir, construire et maintenir des services de backend en utilisant Java (Spring Boot) et Python pour le calcul d'index et les plateformes de traitement de données

• Posséder la livraison de bout en bout des fonctionnalités, s'assurer qu'elles sont livrées à temps et répondre aux attentes de qualité

• Diriger la prestation technique d'une équipe d'ingénierie distribuée en Inde, aligner l'équipe et assurer des résultats cohérents et de haute qualité (sans gestion directe de ligne)

• Collaborer avec les équipes du SRE pour s'assurer que les systèmes sont fiables et prêts à la production, contribuant à des améliorations au besoin

• Conduire des décisions d'architecture et d'ingénierie pour améliorer l'évolutivité, la performance et la maintenance

Ce que vous apportez

• Forte expérience pratique en ingénierie logicielle avec Java (Spring Boot) et Python dans un environnement de production

• Expérience en matière de prestation de services dans une structure distribuée, l'accent étant mis sur la responsabilisation et les résultats

• Compréhension solide de la conception et de la distribution des systèmes de moteur

• Expérience d'utilisation d'outils d'ingénierie modernes et de développement assisté par l'IA pour améliorer la productivité et la qualité du code

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique ou domaine connexe, ou expérience pratique équivalente dans la construction et l'exploitation de systèmes de production

• Compétences de communication en anglais; l'allemand est un plus

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Mateusz Kozielec au +4158399861 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

Analista di sorveglianza commerciale (80-100%)

Zurigo | Possibilità di lavorare in casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8011

Zurich, up to 40% HomeOffice possible, Reference 8011

Are you interested in the financial markets? This position offers you the chance to experience the stock exchange business at close range and in a unique working environment.

To strengthen our market supervision & Berlin team in Zurich, we are looking for a dedicated person as Trade Surveillance Analyst. In this role, we focus on monitoring, identifying and investigating potential market abuses of trading activities and possible regulatory abuses of market participants. In addition, you actively participate in the further development and optimization of the monitoring systems.

- Monitoring of the trading venue in relation to abnormalities (market manipulation, intra-Community transactions, rule infringements, etc.) accompanied by the conduct of data analyses and the drafting of preliminary clarification and investigation reports on the hands of the supervisory and law enforcement authorities - Contact person for dealers and participants in regulatory issues - Further development or.

Support for monitoring tools and scenarios by identifying trends and patterns - contribution and support of reporting obligations (monthly reports, quarterly reports, etc.) - participation and support of projects in the department

Requirements

- Higher degree (university or university) in economics, finance, etc. or equivalent banking training or several years of compliance experience in the field of trade and investment banking - Ideally, expertise and experience in the trading of various asset classes (shares, bonds, warrants) - Ability to capture complex relationships and to present them to the addressee - A strong analytical thinking ability - Excellent language skills (negotiable in German and English, French desirable)

Investiamo nello sviluppo dei nostri leader e ti sosteniamo in continua espansione delle tue capacità e capacità. Come azienda moderna e innovativa all'incrocio tra tecnologia e finanza, SIX offre una vasta gamma di opportunità per ottenere un impatto significativo e sfruttare appieno il potenziale. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura in inglese. Cosa farai
• Guidare e allenare un team distribuito da remoto di tre specialisti dei social media, promuovendo un approccio strategico al social marketing, una mentalità di consulenza, responsabilità e una delegazione efficace.
• Proprio la strategia di marketing sociale end-to-end attraverso attività pagate e organiche, allineati con obiettivi di business e marketing.

• Agire come partner strategico proattivo per gli stakeholder interni e proporre soluzioni in ambienti contrattati dalle risorse. Che cosa porta
• Laurea in Marketing, Comunicazione, Business, Digital Media o un campo correlato, con almeno 6 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante nel marketing dei social media.

• Profonda competenza nel marketing sociale strategico, comprese le campagne a pagamento, la misurazione delle prestazioni e l'ottimizzazione.
• Dimostrata capacità di allenare le squadre verso un modo consultivo di lavorare, andando oltre consegna puramente esecutiva.

descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Social Marketing

Zurich, Madrid, Warsaw | Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8062

Are you passionate about shaping strategic social marketing at scale and leading teams through transformation? Do you thrive in an international, global environment and enjoy partnering closely with the business to create measurable impact? Then join our international Digital Communications team as Head of Social Marketing. The role can be based in Warsaw (Poland), Madrid (Spain), or Zurich (Switzerland).

In this role, you will lead our social media team and own the strategic direction of paid and organic social marketing across our channels. With your leadership experience, strategic mindset, and drive for excellence, you will help strengthen our brands SIX and BME, elevate our social marketing maturity, and enable your team to act as trusted advisors to the business.

We invest in the development of our leaders and support you in continuously expanding your skills and capabilities.

As a modern, innovative company at the intersection of technology and finance, SIX offers a wide range of opportunities to make a meaningful impact and fully leverage your potential. We look forward to receiving your application in English.

What You Will Do

• Lead and coach a remotely distributed team of three social media specialists, fostering a strategic approach to social marketing, a consultancy mindset, accountability, and effective delegation.

• Own the end‑to‑end social marketing strategy across paid and organic activities, aligned with business and marketing objectives.

• Establish and continuously improve workflows and templates to ensure scalability, quality, and efficiency across remote collaboration.

• Act as the accountable owner for social marketing outcomes, translating goals into KPIs and measurable performance; includes leading crisis management across social channels when applicable.

• Act as a proactive strategic partner to internal stakeholders and propose solutions in resource‑constrained environments.

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Digital Media, or a related field, with at least 6 years of relevant professional experience in social media marketing.

• Proven experience leading remote or virtual social media teams, with strong online leadership, coaching, and people development skills.

• Deep expertise in strategic social marketing, including paid campaigns, performance measurement, and optimization.

• Demonstrated ability to coach teams toward a consultative way of working, moving beyond purely executional delivery.

• Strong process and transformation mindset, with experience building scalable ways of working in complex organizations; fluent English is required, German language skills are highly preferred but not mandatory.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Wir investieren in die Entwicklung unserer Führungskräfte und unterstützen Sie dabei, Ihre Fähigkeiten und Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich auszubauen. Als modernes, innovatives Unternehmen an der Schnittstelle von Technologie und Finanzen bietet SIX eine breite Palette von Möglichkeiten, um sinnvolle Auswirkungen zu erzielen und Ihr Potenzial voll auszuschöpfen. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung in englischer Sprache. Was Sie tun werden
• Führen und coachen Sie ein aus der Ferne verteiltes Team von drei Social-Media-Spezialisten, das einen strategischen Ansatz für Social Marketing, eine Beratungsmentalität, Rechenschaftspflicht und eine effektive Delegation fördert.
• Besitzen Sie die End-to-End-Social-Marketing-Strategie für bezahlte und organische Aktivitäten, die auf Geschäfts- und Marketingziele ausgerichtet sind.
• Einrichtung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Workflows und Vorlagen, um Skalierbarkeit, Qualität und Effizienz in der Remote-Zusammenarbeit zu gewährleisten.
• Handeln Sie als verantwortlicher Eigentümer für Social-Marketing-Ergebnisse, übersetzen Sie Ziele in KPIs und messbare Leistung; schließt gegebenenfalls ein führendes Krisenmanagement über soziale Kanäle hinweg ein.
• Handeln Sie als proaktiver strategischer Partner für interne Stakeholder und schlagen Sie Lösungen in ressourcenbeschränkten Umgebungen vor. Was du mitbringst
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Marketing, Kommunikation, Business, Digital Media oder einem verwandten Bereich, mit mindestens 6 Jahren einschlägiger Berufserfahrung im Social Media Marketing.
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung von Remote- oder virtuellen Social-Media-Teams mit starken Online-Führungs-, Coaching- und Personalentwicklungsfähigkeiten.
• Tiefe Expertise im strategischen Social Marketing, einschließlich bezahlter Kampagnen, Leistungsmessung und Optimierung.
• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, Teams zu einer beratenden Arbeitsweise zu führen, die über die reine Ausführung hinausgeht.
• Starke Prozess- und Transformationsmentalität, mit Erfahrung beim Aufbau skalierbarer Arbeitsweisen in komplexen Organisationen; fließend Englisch ist erforderlich, Deutschkenntnisse sind sehr bevorzugt, aber nicht obligatorisch. Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Agnieszka Leputa unter +48 538 562 645 an Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen. Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers. Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Responsable du marketing social Zurich, Madrid, Varsovie Êtes-vous passionné de façonner le marketing social stratégique à l'échelle et de diriger des équipes par la transformation? prospèrez-vous dans un environnement international et mondial et aimez-vous vous associer étroitement à l'entreprise pour créer un impact mesurable? Ensuite, rejoignez notre équipe internationale de communications numériques en tant que responsable du marketing social. Le rôle peut être basé à Varsovie (Pologne), Madrid (Espagne) ou Zurich (Suisse). Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez notre équipe de médias sociaux et posséderez la direction stratégique du marketing social payé et biologique sur nos canaux. Grâce à votre expérience de leadership, votre esprit d'entreprise stratégique et votre volonté d'excellence, vous aiderez à renforcer nos marques SIX et BME, à élever notre maturité en marketing social et à permettre à votre équipe d'agir en tant que conseillers de confiance pour l'entreprise. Nous investissons dans le développement de nos leaders et vous accompagnons dans le développement continu de vos compétences et de vos capacités. En tant qu'entreprise moderne et innovante à la croisée de la technologie et de la finance, SIX offre un large éventail d'opportunités pour faire un impact significatif et exploiter pleinement votre potentiel. Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature en anglais. Ce que vous ferez
• Dirigez et entraînez une équipe à distance de trois spécialistes des médias sociaux, favorisant une approche stratégique du marketing social, une mentalité de conseil, la responsabilité et une délégation efficace.
• Posséder la stratégie de marketing social de bout en bout pour les activités rémunérées et biologiques, en harmonie avec les objectifs commerciaux et marketing.
• Établir et améliorer continuellement les flux de travail et les modèles pour assurer l'évolutivité, la qualité et l'efficacité de la collaboration à distance.
• Agir en tant que propriétaire responsable des résultats du marketing social, en traduisant les objectifs en ICR et en mesurant la performance; inclure la gestion des crises par les voies sociales, le cas échéant.
• Agir en tant que partenaire stratégique proactif pour les intervenants internes et proposer des solutions dans des environnements où les ressources sont limitées. Ce que vous apportez
• Baccalauréat en marketing, communication, affaires, médias numériques, ou un domaine connexe, avec au moins 6 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente en marketing de médias sociaux.
• Expérience éprouvée dirigeant des équipes de médias sociaux à distance ou virtuels, avec un leadership en ligne solide, un coaching et des compétences de développement des personnes.
• Expertise approfondie en marketing social stratégique, y compris les campagnes rémunérées, la mesure du rendement et l'optimisation.
• Capacité démontrée d'entraîner les équipes vers un mode de travail consultatif, allant au-delà de l'exécution pure.
• Un processus solide et l'esprit de transformation, avec l'expérience de construire des façons évolutives de travailler dans des organisations complexes; l'anglais couramment est nécessaire, les compétences en langue allemande sont hautement préférées mais pas obligatoire. Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Agnieszka Leputa au +48 538 562 645 Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes. La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.
