IT DevOps Engineer

Madrid, Barcelona | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7856

Do you want to work in an agile environment where passion, trust, innovation, and operational robustness are key principles?
Are you motivated to learn, grow your technical skills, and contribute to modern DevOps practices while working alongside experienced engineers?
If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!
We are looking for an Application Ops Engineer to join our Operations Team and support application development teams through automation, standardized CI/CD pipelines, and the configuration of shared operational platforms.
In this role, you will contribute to building and operating scalable deployment and automation solutions, while gaining hands-on experience with tools such as GitLab, Ansible, ArgoCD, Airflow, and Python, and collaborating closely with developers and platform teams to ensure operational quality and Operations best practices across the application lifecycle.

What You Will Do

• Contribute to the design, implementation, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines using GitLab and ArgoCD

• Develop, adapt, and maintain reusable automation templates using Ansible

• Support development teams in integrating deployment pipelines, workflows, and observability configurations

• Assist in the operation and improvement of scheduling and workflow automation platforms such as Airflow

• Write and maintain Python scripts to support automation, integrations, and operational tasks

• Help drive standardization, security, and scalability in build and deployment workflows

• Collaborate with central infrastructure teams on provisioning, upgrades, and shared platform services (e.g. Grafana, Vault, ELK)

• Document processes, configurations, and best practices, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives

• Learn and apply modern DevOps tooling and practices, sharing knowledge within the team

What You Bring

• A strong interest in DevOps and automation across the software delivery lifecycle

• Hands-on experience or practical knowledge of GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, ArgoCD, or similar tools

• Basic experience with Python for scripting or automation purposes

• Familiarity with Linux environments and application deployments

• Exposure to observability or monitoring tools such as Grafana, ELK, Prometheus is a plus

• Willingness to learn, ask questions, and collaborate in a cross-functional environment

• Proactive mindset, good communication skills, and a team-oriented attitude

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo una miscela unica di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Valorizziamo le menti luminose e li ispiriamo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Senior Account Manager (80-100%) Zurigo | fino al 40% lavorando da casa possibile | Reference 7956 Stiamo cercando un esperto Senior Sales & Relationship Manager per entrare nel nostro team Sales Svizzera & Liechtenstein a Zurigo. In questo ruolo, agirai come partner senior e di fiducia per i clienti, possedendo relazioni finiscono per finire e guidando la crescita sostenibile dei ricavi attraverso upselling e cross selling all'interno di conti esistenti. Questa posizione è progettata per un professionista esperto che opera con un alto grado di autonomia, porta un target di vendita significativo, ed è pronto a modellare attivamente i rapporti con i clienti e commerciale Cosa farete
• agire come un punto di contatto senior, fidato per i clienti, gestire complesse indagini, discussioni commerciali e interazioni con fiducia degli stakeholder.
• sviluppare, sviluppare e approfondire relazioni a lungo termine a tutti i livelli all'interno delle organizzazioni dei clienti, compresi i soggetti senior e dirigenti.
• identificare ed eseguire in modo proattivo le opportunità di upselling e cross selling all'interno dei conti esistenti per guidare la crescita dei ricavi verso obiettivi ambiziosi.
• possedere l'onboarding di nuovi clienti e garantire una transizione senza soluzione di continuità nei nostri servizi, gettando le basi per partnership a lungo termine.
• sviluppare una profonda comprensione delle esigenze dei clienti, delle tendenze di mercato e delle dinamiche normative per anticipare le sfide e fornire soluzioni personalizzate e di valore aggiunto.
• collaborare strettamente con team interni per garantire un'elevata qualità di consegna, soddisfazione del cliente e un'esperienza cliente costantemente positiva.
• rappresentare l'azienda come senior ambassador in riunioni dei clienti, touchpoint esecutivi, eventi industriali e conferenze.
• gestire e sviluppare continuamente una robusta pipeline di vendita, fornendo previsioni accurate, reporting trasparente e una chiara visibilità sulle performance commerciali. Cosa Portare
• oltre 10 anni di esperienza nella gestione delle vendite e/o delle relazioni con i clienti, idealmente all'interno di servizi finanziari o un ambiente B2B complesso.
• capacità comprovata di gestire, crescere e mantenere in autonomia i portafogli dei clienti, anche portando e consegnando contro importanti obiettivi di reddito.
• forte comunicazione, negoziazione e capacità di gestione delle parti interessate, con la fiducia di impegnarsi a livello senior ed esecutivo.
• elevato livello di proprietà, responsabilità e acumen commerciale, combinato con una mentalità proattiva e orientata ai risultati.
• eccellenti competenze organizzative e la capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente dinamico e veloce.
• fluenza in inglese e tedesco richiesto; ulteriori lingue sono un vantaggio. Se avete domande, controllare la nostra pagina FAQ o chiamare Beata Czyzewska a +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49. Per questo posto di lavoro accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

In this role, you will act as a senior and trusted partner for clients, owning relationships end to end and driving sustainable revenue growth through upselling and cross selling within existing accounts. This position is designed for a seasoned professional who operates with a high degree of autonomy, carries a significant sales target, and is ready to actively shape client relationships and commercial What You Will Do
• act as a senior, trusted point of contact for clients, managing complex inquiries, commercial discussions, and stakeholder interactions with confidence.
• build, develop, and deepen long term relationships at all levels within client organizations, including senior and executive stakeholders.
• proactively identify and execute upselling and cross selling opportunities within existing accounts to drive revenue growth against ambitious targets.
• own the onboarding of new clients and ensure a seamless transition into our services, laying the foundation for long term partnerships.
• develop a deep understanding of client needs, market trends, and regulatory dynamics to anticipate challenges and deliver tailored, value adding solutions.
• collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure high quality delivery, client satisfaction, and a consistently positive client experience.
• represent the company as a senior ambassador at client meetings, executive touchpoints, industry events, and conferences.
• manage and continuously develop a robust sales pipeline, providing accurate forecasting, transparent reporting, and clear visibility on commercial performance. What You Bring
• over 10 years of experience in sales and/or client relationship management, ideally within financial services or a complex B2B environment.
• proven ability to independently manage, grow, and retain client portfolios, including carrying and delivering against significant revenue targets.
• strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage at senior and executive levels.
• high level of ownership, accountability, and commercial acumen, combined with a proactive and results driven mindset.
• excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast paced environment.
• fluency in English and German required; additional languages are an advantage. Senior Account Manager (80 -100%) Zürich, bis zu 40% von zu Hause aus möglich arbeiten, Referenz 7956 Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Senior Sales & Relationship Manager, der sich unserem Sales Switzerland & Liechtenstein Team in Zürich anschließt. In dieser Rolle werden Sie als Senior und vertrauenswürdiger Partner für Kunden agieren, deren Beziehungen enden und nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum durch Upselling und Crossselling innerhalb bestehender Konten fördern. Diese Position ist für einen erfahrenen Profi konzipiert, der mit einem hohen Grad an Autonomie arbeitet, ein signifikantes Umsatzziel verfolgt und bereit ist, Kundenbeziehungen und kommerzielle Aktivitäten aktiv zu gestalten.Was Sie tun werden
• Sie fungieren als Senior, vertrauenswürdiger Ansprechpartner für Kunden, verwalten komplexe Anfragen, kommerzielle Gespräche und Interaktionen mit Stakeholdern mit Vertrauen.
• langfristige Beziehungen auf allen Ebenen innerhalb von Kundenorganisationen aufbauen, entwickeln und vertiefen, einschließlich hochrangiger und ausführender Stakeholder.
• proaktiv Upsell- und Cross-Selling-Möglichkeiten innerhalb bestehender Konten identifizieren und umsetzen, um das Umsatzwachstum gegenüber ehrgeizigen Zielen zu fördern.
• das Onboarding neuer Kunden besitzen und einen nahtlosen Übergang in unsere Dienstleistungen gewährleisten, die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften bilden.
• ein tiefes Verständnis der Kundenbedürfnisse, Markttrends und regulatorischen Dynamiken entwickeln, um Herausforderungen zu antizipieren und maßgeschneiderte, wertsteigernde Lösungen zu liefern.
• eng mit internen Teams zusammenarbeiten, um eine qualitativ hochwertige Lieferung, Kundenzufriedenheit und eine konsequent positive Kundenerfahrung zu gewährleisten.
• das Unternehmen als Senior Botschafter bei Kundentreffen, Executive Touchpoints, Branchenveranstaltungen und Konferenzen vertreten.
• eine robuste Vertriebspipeline verwalten und kontinuierlich entwickeln, die genaue Prognosen, transparente Berichterstattung und klare Sichtbarkeit bei der kommerziellen Leistung bietet. Was Sie bringen
• über 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertriebs- und/oder Kundenbeziehungsmanagement, ideal innerhalb von Finanzdienstleistungen oder einem komplexen B2B-Umfeld.
• bewährte Fähigkeit, Kundenportfolios unabhängig zu verwalten, zu wachsen und zu halten, einschließlich der Durchführung und Umsetzung von erheblichen Umsatzzielen.
• starke Kommunikation, Verhandlungen und Stakeholdermanagement-Fähigkeiten, mit dem Vertrauen, auf Senior- und Executive-Ebene zu engagieren.
• hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Rechenschaftspflicht und kommerziellem Scharfsinn, kombiniert mit einer proaktiven und ergebnisorientierten Denkweise.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX est un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondation et de croissance. Nous valorisons les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Senior Account Manager (80 -100%) Zurich, jusqu'à 40% de travail à domicile possible, Référence 7956 Nous recherchons un Senior Sales & Relationship Manager expérimenté pour rejoindre notre équipe Ventes Suisse & Liechtenstein à Zurich. Dans ce rôle, vous agirez comme partenaire principal et de confiance pour les clients, possédant des relations fin à fin et conduisant à une croissance durable des revenus par la vente à plus haut niveau et la vente croisée dans les comptes existants.Ce poste est conçu pour un professionnel expérimenté qui fonctionne avec un haut degré d'autonomie, porte une cible de vente importante, et est prêt à façonner activement les relations client et commerciale Ce que vous ferez
• agir comme un point de contact supérieur et de confiance pour les clients, gérer des demandes complexes, des discussions commerciales et des interactions avec les intervenants avec confiance.
• établir, développer et approfondir des relations à long terme à tous les niveaux au sein des organisations clientes, y compris les acteurs supérieurs et exécutifs.
• identifier et exécuter de manière proactive des opportunités de vente à haut niveau et de vente croisée dans les comptes existants pour stimuler la croissance des revenus par rapport à des objectifs ambitieux.
• posséder l'intégration de nouveaux clients et assurer une transition transparente dans nos services, en jetant les bases de partenariats à long terme.
• développer une compréhension approfondie des besoins des clients, des tendances du marché et de la dynamique réglementaire pour anticiper les défis et fournir des solutions adaptées et à valeur ajoutée.
• collaborer étroitement avec les équipes internes pour assurer une prestation de haute qualité, la satisfaction de la clientèle et une expérience client toujours positive.
• représenter l'entreprise comme ambassadeur principal lors des réunions de clients, des points de contact exécutifs, des événements industriels et des conférences.
• gérer et développer en permanence un solide pipeline de ventes, fournissant des prévisions précises, des rapports transparents et une visibilité claire sur les performances commerciales.
• la capacité éprouvée de gérer, de développer et de conserver de façon indépendante les portefeuilles de clients, y compris en réalisant et en exécutant des objectifs de recettes significatifs.
• les compétences solides en communication, négociation et gestion des parties prenantes, avec la confiance nécessaire pour engager les cadres supérieurs et les cadres supérieurs.
• le haut niveau d'appropriation, de responsabilité et d'aumône commerciale, combiné à une attitude proactive et axée sur les résultats.
• les compétences organisationnelles excellentes et la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement dynamique et rapide.
• maîtrise de l'anglais et de l'allemand requis; les langues supplémentaires sont un avantage. Senior Solution Architect - Workplace Warsaw | up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7538 Would you like to help us to transform our IT Infrastructure, drive our cloud journey and bring our services to the next level? Are you passionate about technology? Then, we want to hear from you! As part of SIX IT Infrastructure & Operations, we continuously innovate our customer's experience by providing technically mature, sustainable, and up-to-date services. You will contribute to that by ensuring that our building blocks are fit for purpose and well aligned. What You Will Do
• Drive the design and integration of workplace solutions into the enterprise IT landscape, ensuring alignment with architectural standards and business objectives
• Lead solution architecture for projects, validating requirements and ensuring compliance with security, risk, and regulatory frameworks
• Define and maintain the digital workplace roadmap, incorporating emerging technologies such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, automation, and zero-trust principles
• Collaborate with IT Competence Centers and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and user-centric solutions
• Establish measurable success criteria for adoption, compliance, and operational efficiency, and report progress to senior leadership What You Bring
• Degree in IT or Computer Science; industry certifications (e.g., Microsoft, ITIL) are an advantage
• Proven experience as a Workplace Solution Architect in complex, regulated environments (finance or pharma preferred)
• Expertise in designing and integrating enterprise-grade solutions using M365, Exchange, SharePoint, Intune, and modern workplace technologies
• Strong analytical and consulting skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and manage competing priorities pragmatically
• Excellent written and verbal communication in English for both technical and business contexts; German and/or Spanish is a strong plus If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 . Fixed Income Surveillance Specialist Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8058 BME is the operator of all securities markets and financial systems in our country and is part of the SIX Group. In Fixed Income surveillance team we are looking for a person to join the team to cover the daily basis. As a Fixed Income operation technician you will be learning how to manage our data bases and our trading platforms: AIAF, MARF and SENAF. You will work in a motivated, dynamic environment in which we are responsible for Fixed Income Market. What You Will Do
• Registration and maintenance of issues in the data base
• Surveillance of the Fixed income Markets (checking positions, trades, market abuse, doing EOD files & procedures)
• Management of Members and system connections
• Collaboration on the testing version updates
• Monitorization and helpdesk support to Members, both national and international What You Bring
• Bachelor's degree in Economics, Business Administration or any related field. Studies related with financial sector or Capital Markets will be a plus
• A minimum of 2 years of experience in the financial sector and in an operational or back office area
• Good written and oral level of English and Spanish, minimum a B2
• Thorough, proactive and decisive person, with good teamwork skills
• Attention to details and patience personality to avoid committing errors
• Availability to work in weekly rotatory shifts (from 8:00h to 16:30h and from 9:30 to 18:00 h) If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 . QA Tester Warsaw | Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7842 Location: Warsaw (hybrid) About the Role We are looking for an experienced QA Tester to join our team in Warsaw. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our applications across both project-based initiatives and ongoing change activities. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, applying strong analytical skills, structured testing approaches, and excellent communication to deliver high quality results. What You Will Do
• Plan, prepare, execute, and document test activities
• Manage all aspects of the QA lifecycle, including defect management & progress tracking
• Develop and maintain high-quality test artefacts using JIRA/Xray and Confluence.
• Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders.
• Estimate test efforts and support tool evaluations to optimize testing efficiency.
• Apply automation and AI-driven testing techniques to improve test coverage
• Work in Agile and SAFE environments, adapting testing practices to evolving needs.
• Manage multiple tasks and priorities while ensuring timely and high quality delivery. What You Bring
• Proven experience in managing QA activities across projects and change requests.
• Strong understanding of SW testing principles, methodologies, and best practices.
• Structured and methodical approach to testing.
• Practical experience working in Agile and SAFe frameworks.
• Hands-on experience with JIRA/Xray and Confluence for test documentation.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
• Ability to explain risks, issues, and test results to non technical stakeholders.
• Ability to set priorities, manage deadlines, and handle multiple parallel tasks.
• Skilled in estimating test efforts and evaluating testing tools.
• Fintech experience (reference data or market data processing) .
• Advanced knowledge of data analysis or data processing tools.
• Scripting skills (e.g. python) If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Stage di marketing Madrid | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8092 Sei appassionato di marketing, mercati finanziari e la creazione di un impatto significativo? Unisciti al nostro team di Exchange Marketing di Madrid e supporta l'esecuzione di iniziative di marketing nei mercati primari e secondari. Nell'ambito del team, contribuirai alla pianificazione e alla consegna di campagne, eventi e attività digitali che promuovono i mercati dei capitali, gli elenchi e l'impegno degli investitori. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con colleghi in Spagna, Svizzera e in tutta Europa, acquisendo esperienza pratica in un ambiente internazionale e veloce. Applica ora con il tuo CV in inglese. Vogliamo sentirti! Cosa farai
• Sostenere la pianificazione e l'esecuzione di eventi di marketing (ad esempio conferenze, eventi IPO, roadshow)
• Assistere nell'organizzazione di webinar, podcast e formati educativi
• Mantenere e aggiornare il contenuto del sito e le pagine di atterraggio
• Contribuire alla creazione di materiali di marketing (presentazioni, visuali, beni di base)
• Sostenere le attività di marketing digitale e social media
• Assistere con compiti amministrativi (ad esempio fatturazione, coordinamento con i fornitori)
• Aiuta a organizzare meeting aziendali locali e attivazioni di marketing
• Collabora con le parti interessate interne nei team Marketing, Vendite e Prodotto Che cosa porta
• Attualmente iscritta a un programma di Bachelor o Master (Marketing, Business, Finanza, o simili)
• Forte interesse nei mercati finanziari e nel marketing
• La prima esperienza nel marketing, nelle comunicazioni o negli eventi è un plus
• Forte capacità organizzative e attenzione ai dettagli
• Stile di lavoro attivo e affidabile con una mentalità hands-on
• Forte capacità di comunicazione in spagnolo e inglese

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Java Backed Developer (Kubernetes) Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7931 SIX is looking for an experienced Software Engineer to help shape and evolve our API Management Platform and developer experience. You will drive roadmap topics, bring your own ideas, and own solutions end-to-end—from design to production operations. You’ll have the space to propose, prototype, and productize platform capabilities that measurably improve adoption and time-to-integrate for consuming teams. Working across multiple lines of business, you will turn business use cases into simple, secure platform capabilities and drive adoption through standards, automation, and documentation. You will partner with Architects, Engineers, Service Managers, and Security—making pragmatic trade-offs, clarifying ambiguity, and raising the bar for reliability (SLOs, observability, post-incident improvements). You thrive in an Agile, DevOps-oriented team and enjoy taking responsibility for outcomes—not just delivering tickets. What You Will Do
• Drive roadmap topics, propose improvements, and own whole epics end-to-end; set patterns and guardrails for the API platform
• Design and build backend services and automation APIs (REST) for self-service platform workflows on OpenShift, balancing simplicity, security, and scalability
• Improve CI/CD, automated tests, and quality gates to shorten lead time and increase confidence in production changes
• Drive API standards and platform guardrails (e.g., OpenAPI, security patterns) with Architecture and Security; enable teams with clear docs and examples
• Own reliability for your components: observability (metrics, logs, tracing), SLOs, runbooks, and post-incident improvements; contribute to security assessments/audits
• Take part in the on-call rotation (L1/L2) and reduce operational load through automation and continuous improvement What You Bring
• Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot, building and operating API-based services (REST, microservices) in production
• Engineering judgment and craftsmanship (Clean Code/Clean Architecture), with an ownership mindset and focus on maintainability
• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift, plus infrastructure as code and production operations
• Hands-on CI/CD and build automation (e.g., Maven), including pipelines, test strategies, and deployment automation
• Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and performance-aware data access
• Practical experience owning API lifecycle topics (OpenAPI, versioning, backward compatibility, and consumer-facing documentation)
• Good understanding of API security (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, least privilege) and experience with reviews and audits
• Strong lifecycle management in Agile teams; comfortable leading technical discussions and aligning stakeholders If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift, plus infrastructure as code and production operations
• Hands-on CI/CD and build automation (e.g., Maven), including pipelines, test strategies, and deployment automation
• Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and performance-aware data access
• Practical experience owning API lifecycle topics (OpenAPI, versioning, backward compatibility, and consumer-facing documentation)
• Good understanding of API security (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, least privilege) and experience with reviews and audits
• Strong lifecycle management in Agile teams; comfortable leading technical discussions and aligning stakeholders If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Project Management Officer Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7958 We are looking for an experienced Project Management Officer (PMO) to strengthen the delivery and governance of projects within SIX Securities Services, a leading provider of post trade services in the financial industry. This role sits within the Business Support department and acts as an internal consulting function, supporting project teams and senior stakeholders to ensure high quality, on time and on budget project delivery across a complex and regulated environment. As part of the team you will work in an international financial services environment, contributing to the continuous development of project management capabilities while supporting strategic initiatives with real business impact. Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English. We are looking forward to hear from you. What You Will Do
• Plan, monitor and control project deliverables, milestones and KPIs, mantaining and structured project communication and stakeholder management
• Support and coordinate project team meetings, project boards, workshops and steering committees
• Perform project controlling activities, including financial reporting and actively manage RAID topics (Risks, Assumptions, Issues and Decisions)
• Define, maintain and continuously improve project management methods, standards, documentation and templates
• Collaborate in the harmonisation, optimisation and innovation of project management processes and support the onboarding of new employees into the division’s project environment
• Capture lessons learned and proactively propose improvements What You Bring
• University degree in IT, finance, business management or any related field. PMP or PRINCE 2 certifications will be valuable.
• At least 5 years of experience in a Project Management Office or similar role
• Solid project management skills, including agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum) . Jira/Confluence
• Good understanding of financial services, banking and/or insurance processes is an advantage
• Strong analytical, organizational and communication skills with a proactive, structured and result oriented mindset with also a strong customer focus
• Fluent written and spoken English and Spanish If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <div dir="auto" style=" " class="buttontext buttontextdaaac1fecd1a5554 rtltextaligneligible

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX ci spinge alla trasformazione dei mercati finanziari. Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo una miscela unica di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Valorizziamo le menti brillanti e le ispiriamo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Senior Enterprise Architect Zurich | 80-100% | Reference 8038 Sei appassionato di modellare l'evoluzione dell'architettura imprenditoriale in un ambiente complesso e altamente regolamentato? Il nostro team di Enterprise Architecture definisce e guida il paesaggio architettonico attraverso i domini aziendali e IT, garantendo l'allineamento con priorità strategiche, aspettative normative e creazione di valore a lungo termine. In questo ruolo, contribuirete allo sviluppo e alla governance delle architetture end-to-end tra settori aziendali, applicativi, dati e tecnologici. Agiterete come consulenti affidabili per i soggetti IT e business senior, sostenendo il processo decisionale, guidando la coerenza e rafforzando la disciplina complessiva dell'architettura. Cosa farete
• sviluppare e sviluppare l'architettura aziendale in più settori (business, applicazioni, dati, tecnologia)
• sostenere e sfidare le iniziative IT e business per garantire l'allineamento con i principi architettonici e gli obiettivi strategici
• agire come partner di riferimento per gli stakeholder senior, tra cui leadership IT, team di prodotti e architetti di dominio
• contribuire alla governance dell'architettura, standard e processi decisionali
• facilitare l'allineamento tra capacità aziendali, soluzioni IT e requisiti normativi
• sostenere la definizione e la comunicazione di
• una solida esperienza nell'architettura d'impresa o un ruolo comparabile con l'esposizione a molteplici domini di architettura
• una vasta comprensione dei processi aziendali, delle applicazioni, dei dati e dei paesaggi infrastrutturali (non limitata ad una specializzazione)
• la capacità di operare in un ambiente complesso e regolamentato e di bilanciare la governance con le esigenze di erogazione
• una forte capacità di gestione delle parti interessate, con la capacità di influenzare e sfidare in modo costruttivo a livelli senior
• Pensiero strutturato con una mentalità pragmatica e orientata ai risultati
• esperienza in servizi finanziari o altre industrie regolamentate è un plus
• master.s laurea in campo scientifico o tecnico; i diplomi avanzati sono un plus
• fluente in inglese; il tedesco è un vantaggio Se avete domande, controllare la nostra pagina FAQ o chiamare Mateusz Kozielec a +41583998611. Per questo posto vacante accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Senior Enterprise Architect Zurich | 80-100% | Reference 8038 Are you passionate about shaping the evolution of enterprise architecture in a complex and highly regulated environment? Our Enterprise Architecture team defines and steers the architectural landscape across business and IT domains, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities, regulatory expectations, and long-term value creation. In this role, you will contribute to the development and governance of end-to-end architectures across business, application, data, and technology domains. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business stakeholders, supporting decision-making, driving consistency, and strengthening the overall architecture discipline. What You Will Do
• develop and evolve enterprise architecture across multiple domains (business, application, data, technology)
• support and challenge IT and business initiatives to ensure alignment with architectural principles and strategic objectives
• act as a sparring partner for senior stakeholders, including IT leadership, product teams, and domain architects
• contribute to architecture governance, standards, and decision-making processes
• facilitate alignment between business capabilities, IT solutions, and regulatory requirements
• support the definition and communication of architectural roadmaps and target states
• drive transparency and consistency across architectural artefacts and practices What You Bring
• solid experience in enterprise architecture or a comparable role with exposure to multiple architecture domains
• broad understanding of business processes, applications, data, and infrastructure landscapes (not limited to one specialization)
• ability to operate in a complex, regulated environment and balance governance with delivery needs
• strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and challenge constructively at senior levels
• structured thinking with a pragmatic and outcome-oriented mindset
• experience in financial services or other regulated industries is a plus
• master’s degree in a scientific or technical field; advanced degrees are a plus
• fluent in English; German is an advantage If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
descriptionByLocale.de:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran. Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen die Intelligenz und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie die Zukunft der Finanzen mit uns. Senior Enterprise Architect Zürich, 80-100%, Reference 8038 Sie sind leidenschaftlich dabei, die Evolution der Unternehmensarchitektur in einem komplexen und hochregulierten Umfeld zu gestalten? Unser Enterprise Architecture Team definiert und steuert die Architekturlandschaft über Geschäfts- und IT-Bereiche hinweg und gewährleistet die Ausrichtung auf strategische Prioritäten, regulatorische Erwartungen und langfristige Wertschöpfung. In dieser Rolle tragen Sie zur Entwicklung und Governance von durchgängigen Architekturen in Geschäfts-, Anwendungs-, Daten- und Technologiebereichen bei. Sie agieren als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für hochrangige IT- und Business-Stakeholder, unterstützen Entscheidungsfindung, treiben Konsistenz und stärken die gesamte Architekturdisziplin. Was Sie tun werden
• Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung der Unternehmensarchitektur über mehrere Bereiche (Business, Application, Data, Technologie) hinweg
• Unterstützung und Herausforderung von IT- und Geschäftsinitiativen zur Gewährleistung der Ausrichtung auf architektonische Prinzipien und strategische Ziele

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Business Development & Strategy Specialist Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7587 SIX Securities Services are powers the core post-trade infrastructure for Swiss, Spanish and international markets. From clearing and settlement to custody and collateral management, we ensure securities transactions are processed safely, efficiently, and reliably across markets. BSS runs interoperable CCP and CSD platforms, connects participants worldwide, and delivers value-added services that support banks, brokers, and institutional investors throughout the full post-trade lifecycle. Our Business Development & Strategy team sits within the BSS COO organization, which spans all products and drives strategy execution, transformation, and performance. We complement the product and business development experts in each product vertical and are responsible for executing strategy across BSS and unlocking new growth. We lead transversal initiatives, cultivate strategic partnerships, and identify cross-Business Unit synergies. Our remit includes shaping and executing M&A, steering priority strategic programs, and turning data into action through business intelligence and analytics. We also enable our commercial teams with strategic sales support to maximize market impact. As a Business Development & Strategy Specialist, you’ll help shape the future of SIX Securities Services by driving initiatives that span the entire post-trade value chain. You’ll operate at the intersection of strategy, business development and market intelligence—translating ideas into tangible growth and supporting execution across all product areas (Clearing, Custody, Securities Finance, and Trade Repositories). This high-visibility role offers close collaboration with senior leadership, product teams and external partners—giving you a front-row seat to influence direction and deliver measurable results. What You Will Do
• Shape and drive strategic growth initiatives across the Securities Services value chain – connecting the product verticals Clearing, Custody, Securities Finance and Trade Repositories into integrated, client-centric solutions.
• Translate strategic priorities into actionable initiatives by developing business cases, coordinating stakeholders across product verticals and Business Units (Exchanges, Financial Information and Banking Services) and supporting execution.
• Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify trends, client needs and partnership opportunities that impact and enhance SIX’s positioning as leading European Financial Market Infrastructure
• Support strategic projects and M&A activities, including opportunity assessment, due diligence and integration preparation.
• Develop management insights and communication materials – dashboards, presentations, and reports – to enable informed decisions and track progress on strategic initiatives. What You Bring
• Educational background in finance, economics or business administration with strong understanding of financial service industry and trends
• A minimum of 3 years of experience in capital markets, financial market infrastructure or securities services, ideally in clearing, settlement, custody, securities finance incl. collateral management or trade repositories. Relevant work experience in consulting, corporate strategy or investment banking is a plus
• Strong analytical, conceptual and strategic thinking skills with proven ability to translate complex market and business insights into actionable plans, combined with excellent problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, capable of engaging both internal management and external partners
• Structured and proactive working style, comfortable coordinating multiple stakeholders across business lines, locations, and hierarchies
• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing); German and/or Spanish as a plus If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <div dir="auto" style=" " class="buttontext buttontextfbe84cb3b14a5450 rtltextaligneligible ce

We seek a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our SRE Department in Warsaw, responsible for driving automation and reliability, owning CI/CD pipelines, and managing incident response. Be part of a team that values collaboration, trust, innovation, and continuous improvement. We are looking for a professional with very strong Shell scripting and Python skill set to bring to the team What You Will Do
• Drive automation and reliability across platforms to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.
• Own CI/CD pipelines and release processes, ensuring secure and scalable delivery of applications.
• Handle incident response and collaborate with development teams to maintain system stability.
• Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues to ensure high availability and performance.

Senior Corporate Administration Lead London | hybrid working 60/40 | Reference 7954 Job Introduction Are you driven by strong governance and confident operating in regulated environments? Do you enjoy combining strategic oversight with hands on delivery? REGIS-TR are looking for a Senior Corporate Administration Lead to sit at the heart of the organisation’s governance and regulatory framework, working closely with senior leaders, the Board and external partners. The role offers high visibility and real influence, spanning corporate governance, outsourcing oversight, claims management and risk. You will lead critical processes, ensure regulatory compliance and drive continuous improvement, while acting as a trusted adviser across the business and delivering assurance with precision and judgement. What You Will Do • Manage financial oversight and supplier relationships, including invoice validation, payment reconciliation, tax compliance, banking arrangements and effective vendor controls. • Lead the outsourcing framework, owning policy implementation, managing third party providers, managing contracts, and monitoring performance against regulatory and service standards. • Own claims management and risk oversight, acting as the focal point for claims activity and leading the annual Corporate Affairs risk review and mitigation planning. • Act as a key Corporate Affairs partner for REGIS-TR, working with internal and external stakeholders to ensure regulatory compliance, including regular and ad-hoc FCA reporting, and smooth delivery of governance priorities. • Manage the annual accounts process, coordinating with Finance colleagues and the statutory auditor to ensure that the annual accounts and Directors’ report are prepared and approved according to agreed timescales What You Bring • University degree in economics, finance, banking and/or a comparable education • While not essential, knowledge of SAP would be considered a distinct advantage • Superb organisational skills, flexible, result oriented, fast acting • Excellent communication skills; customer and service orientation • Language: Fluent English mandatory; knowledge of an additional language would be advantageous (particularly German or Spanish) If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. What We Offer Flexible Work Models We trust our employees and offer a work environment that is well-balanced, productive and fosters success.

Business Analyst Warsaw | working from home up to 40% | Reference 7639 Introduction Do you like working close to real data and seeing the impact of your work in production? • Ensure secure data transfer and manage ongoing data changes
• Identify risks early and drive improvements or automation opportunities
• Collaborate with Product, IT, and Operations, and support testing, documentation, and releases What you will bring
• 2 to 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst in financial or reference data
• Solid understanding of instrument and issuer master data concepts
• Experience working with multiple data sources and aligning them into a consistent view
• Hands-on experience with validation, reconciliation, and exception handling
• Ability to write clear specifications and acceptance criteria and work with common data formats (CSV, JSON, XML) and tools
• Strong analytical and technical skills (SQL, advanced Excel, basic Python), familiarity with Jira and Confluence, and clear communication in English If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 . IT Solution Designer Warsaw, Madrid | Working form home up to 40% possible | Reference 7776 Do you want to work in a highly dynamic environment? Are you passionate about architecture and technology? Join our growing Architecture Practice as an IT Solution Designer / Application Architect supporting our dynamic teams, shaping the architecture of applications as we transform to meet the ever-evolving demands of our products and business. We are looking for a professional driven by passion for data, technology transformation, and cross-functional collaboration. As a member of our Architecture team, your influence will not just shape the architecture and our engagement across the department, but also help chart the course for our future state. What You Will Do:
• Design, drive, and maintain end‑to‑end solution architectures in close collaboration with Senior Architects, development teams, and business stakeholders, ensuring alignment with target architecture, principles, standards, and governance.
• Shape and evolve the future‑state architecture and technology roadmap across the landscape, contributing to strategic architectural decisions and long‑term modernization initiatives.

• Build strong, trust‑based relationships with business stakeholders, developers, and fellow architects to translate business needs into robust, scalable, and well‑documented architectural solutions.
• Ensure adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security, risk, and regulatory requirements, while supporting technology evaluations and the design and delivery of proofs of concept and prototypes. What you will bring:
• 3+ years in a technical leadership capacity, 5+ years in an architecture capacity, with experience in the global financial services sector, particularly in Financial Information and high-volume Data Management at scale a plus
• Good knowledge of diverse technologies and solution architecture patterns, and with a drive for innovation. Experience with both on-premise and Cloud technologies and architecture paradigms, and the trade-offs between them.
• Understanding of AI technologies, integration patterns and emerging standards, and the foundational capabilities to enable AI growth and adoption

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari. Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Senior IT Business Manager Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8052 Il CIO Office di SIX supporta il CIO nel guidare l'organizzazione IT con chiarezza, attenzione e impatto. Al suo centro, l'Ufficio traduce la strategia IT in esecuzione, assicura trasparenza e allineamento attraverso l'IT e guida la consegna di iniziative chiave di trasformazione. Il ruolo di Senior IT Business Manager è una posizione centrale, volutamente ampia all'interno di questa configurazione. Offre l'opportunità di operare all'incrocio tra strategia, governance e esecuzione, con esposizione diretta al CIO e leadership senior. Cosa farai
• CIO Enablement & Executive Steering: Sostenere il CIO in argomenti chiave IT, compresa la preparazione di materiali decisionali, presentazioni di gestione e narrazioni strategiche
• Governance & Leadership Support: Orchestrare e preparare forum di governance chiave (ad esempio, formati di Consiglio e leadership) e garantire il follow-up e la trasparenza strutturati.
• Esecuzione di strategia: contribuire attivamente all'esecuzione della strategia IT e di trasformazione, compresa la gestione di iniziative interfunzionali.
• Orchestrazione interfunzionale: Collegare e coordinare gli argomenti tra le unità IT e business, tra cui la gestione delle dipendenze, delle priorità e delle escalation.
• Argomenti strategici e operativi Ad-hoc: Guidare e fornire una vasta gamma di argomenti “CIO Enablement” (ad esempio, mandati, RfP, workshop, formati di comunicazione) con alta visibilità e impatto.
• Consegna a mano attraverso i livelli: Capacità di passare tra discussioni strategiche di alto livello e esecuzione operativa dettagliata mantenendo la consistenza end-to-end. Che cosa porta
• Laurea universitaria (tecnologia, affari o simili), B.A. o superiore.
• 5-10 anni di esperienza professionale, idealmente in ambienti IT, strategia o trasformazione.
• Prove capacità di impegnarsi e collaborare con gli stakeholder senior combinati con una comunicazione chiara ed efficace.
• Hands-on, strutturato e pragmatico approccio con un forte atteggiamento “can-do” e la capacità di guidare in modo indipendente argomenti per i risultati.
• Alto impegno e motivazione, spiccata disponibilità ad assumersi la responsabilità.
• La fluenza in inglese è un must; il tedesco è un plus. Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Mateusz Kozielec al numero +41583998611 . Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale. <span class="fontcolorfe3104f33e8bf462"

At its core, the Office translates IT strategy into execution, ensures transparency and alignment across IT, and drives delivery of key transformation initiatives. The role of Senior IT Business Manager is a central, deliberately broad position within this setup. It offers the opportunity to operate at the intersection of strategy, governance, and execution, with direct exposure to the CIO and senior leadership. What You Will Do
• CIO Enablement & Executive Steering: Support the CIO in steering key IT topics, including preparation of decision materials, management presentations, and strategic narratives
• Governance & Leadership Support: Orchestrate and prepare key governance forums (e.g., Board and leadership formats) and ensure structured follow-up and transparency.
• Strategy Execution: Actively contribute to the execution of the IT and transformation strategy, including managing cross-functional initiatives.
• Cross-functional Orchestration: Connect and coordinate topics across IT and business units, including managing dependencies, priorities, and escalations.
• Ad-hoc Strategic & Operational Topics: Lead and deliver a broad variety of “CIO Enablement” topics (e.g., mandates, RfPs, workshops, communication formats) with high visibility and impact.
• Hands-on Delivery across Levels: Ability to switch between high-level strategic discussions and detailed operational execution while maintaining end-to-end consistency. What You Bring
• University degree (technology, business, or similar), B.A. or higher.
• 5-10 years of professional experience, ideally in IT, strategy, or transformation environments.
• Proven ability to engage and collaborate with senior stakeholders combined with clear and effective communication.
• Hands-on, structured and pragmatic approach with a strong “can-do” attitude and the ability to independently drive topics to results.
• High commitment and motivation, distinct readiness to take on responsibility.
• Fluency in English is a must; German is a plus. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran. Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen. Senior IT Business Manager Zürich | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% möglich | Referenz 8052 Das CIO Office bei SIX unterstützt den CIO dabei, die IT-Organisation mit Klarheit, Fokus und Wirkung zu steuern. Im Kern übersetzt das Office die IT-Strategie in die Ausführung, sorgt für Transparenz und Ausrichtung in der gesamten IT und treibt die Umsetzung wichtiger Transformationsinitiativen voran. Die Rolle des Senior IT Business Managers ist eine zentrale, bewusst breite Position innerhalb dieses Setups. Es bietet die Möglichkeit, an der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Governance und Umsetzung zu operieren, mit direktem Kontakt zum CIO und zur Geschäftsleitung. Was Sie tun werden
• CIO Enablement & Executive Steering: Unterstützung des CIO bei der Steuerung wichtiger IT-Themen, einschließlich der Erstellung von Entscheidungsunterlagen, Managementpräsentationen und strategischen Erzählungen
• Governance & Leadership Support: Orchestrieren und bereiten Sie wichtige Governance-Foren (z. B. Board- und Führungsformate) vor und gewährleisten Sie eine strukturierte Nachverfolgung und Transparenz.
• Strategieausführung: Tragen Sie aktiv zur Umsetzung der IT- und Transformationsstrategie bei, einschließlich der Verwaltung funktionsübergreifender Initiativen.
• Cross-functional Orchestration: Verbinden und koordinieren Sie Themen über IT- und Geschäftseinheiten hinweg, einschließlich der Verwaltung von Abhängigkeiten, Prioritäten und Eskalationen.
• Ad-hoc Strategische und operative Themen: Führen und liefern Sie eine breite Palette von "CIO Enablement" -Themen (z. B. Mandate, RfPs, Workshops, Kommunikationsformate) mit hoher Sichtbarkeit und Wirkung.
• Hands-on Delivery across Levels: Möglichkeit, zwischen hochrangigen strategischen Diskussionen und detaillierter operativer Ausführung zu wechseln und gleichzeitig die Konsistenz von Ende zu Ende zu wahren. Was du mitbringst
• Universitätsabschluss (Technologie, Business oder ähnliches), BA oder höher.
• 5-10 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in IT-, Strategie- oder Transformationsumgebungen.
• Bewährte Fähigkeit, hochrangige Interessengruppen zu engagieren und mit ihnen zusammenzuarbeiten, kombiniert mit einer klaren und effektiven Kommunikation.
• Hands-on, strukturierter und pragmatischer Ansatz mit einer starken „Can-do-Haltung und der Fähigkeit, Themen selbstständig zu Ergebnissen zu führen.
• Hohes Engagement und Motivation, ausgeprägte Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
• Englisch fließend ist ein Muss; Deutsch ist ein Plus. Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Mateusz Kozielec unter +41583998611 an. Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen. Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund. <span class="fontcolorfe3104f33e8bf462"
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers. Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Directeur principal des affaires informatiques Zurich: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% possible Le Bureau du DPI de SIX aide le DPI à diriger l'organisation de la TI avec clarté, concentration et impact. Au centre de ses activités, le Bureau traduit la stratégie informatique en exécution, assure la transparence et l'alignement dans l'ensemble des TI, et dirige la mise en oeuvre des principales initiatives de transformation. Le rôle de Senior IT Business Manager est un poste central, délibérément large dans cette configuration. Il offre l'occasion d'opérer à l'intersection de la stratégie, de la gouvernance et de l'exécution, avec une exposition directe au DPI et aux cadres supérieurs. Ce que vous ferez
• Mise en oeuvre de la DPI et direction exécutive : aider la DPI à diriger les principaux sujets de TI, y compris la préparation de documents décisionnels, de présentations de la direction et de récits stratégiques
• Soutien à la gouvernance et au leadership : orchestrez et préparez des forums clés sur la gouvernance (p. ex., le conseil d'administration et le leadership) et assurez un suivi structuré et la transparence.
• Exécution de la stratégie : Contribuer activement à l'exécution de la stratégie de TI et de transformation, y compris la gestion des initiatives interfonctionnelles.
• Orchestration interfonctionnelle : Connectez et coordonnez des sujets dans toutes les unités informatiques et commerciales, y compris la gestion des dépendances, des priorités et des escalades.
• Sujets stratégiques et opérationnels ad hoc : Diriger et offrir une grande variété de sujets d'Activation de l'ICO (p. ex. mandats, RfP, ateliers, formats de communication) avec une grande visibilité et impact.
• Exécution pratique à tous les niveaux : Capacité de passer de discussions stratégiques de haut niveau à une exécution opérationnelle détaillée tout en maintenant l'uniformité de bout en bout. Ce que vous apportez
• Diplôme universitaire (technologie, commerce, ou similaire), baccalauréat ou supérieur.
• 5-10 ans d'expérience professionnelle, idéalement dans les environnements informatiques, stratégiques ou de transformation.
• Capacité éprouvée d'engager et de collaborer avec les intervenants supérieurs, combinée à une communication claire et efficace.
• Une approche pratique, structurée et pragmatique avec une forte attitude de «can-do» et la capacité de conduire indépendamment les sujets aux résultats.
• Un engagement et une motivation élevés, une volonté d'assumer la responsabilité.
• La maîtrise de l'anglais est un must; l'allemand est un plus. Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Mateusz Kozielec au +4158399861 . Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes. La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel. <span class="fontcolorfe3104f33e8bf462"

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Quality Assurance Engineer Madrid | Work from home up to 40% | Reference 7648 Do you want to be part of a dynamic environment where software quality is a top priority? Are you passionate about ensuring robust, reliable, and high‑performance products? If so, our quality team wants to hear from you! We are an agile team focused on ensuring that our solutions meet the highest quality standards. We are responsible for validating key functionalities, automating tests, and continuously improving our testing processes. Our goal is to deliver an impeccable user experience and guarantee product stability in every release. In this role, you will work closely with developers, product owners, and other QA engineers, participating in the entire development lifecycle to ensure quality from day one. What You Will Do
• Design, execute, and automate backend and end‑to‑end tests using Java and JavaScript, ensuring the quality and stability of developed services.
• Validate data‑processing microservices architectures, including Spark‑ and Cloudera‑based components, as well as Kafka integrations and data consolidation/transformation checks.
• Perform and analyze performance tests using JMeter, identifying improvement areas, detecting potential bottlenecks, and producing detailed technical reports.
• Manage and document the full testing lifecycle using Xray: test case design, sprint execution, incident tracking, and functional/technical certification of releases.
• Collaborate continuously with development, business, and monitoring teams, providing technical documentation in English and defining validation procedures for deployments to production environments What You Bring
• Strong technical skills in Java and JavaScript, with proven experience in test automation using the Karate framework to ensure backend service quality and consistency.
• Solid knowledge of backend ecosystems and data‑driven environments, including Kafka integrations, Spark‑based pipeline development and validation, and experience with data‑management platforms such as Cloudera.
• Demonstrated experience with quality assurance tools and methodologies, particularly continuous integration with GitLab, performance testing with JMeter, and test lifecycle management using Xray.
• Ability to develop supporting automation scripts in Python to streamline tasks and support various testing frameworks.
• Excellent communication and documentation skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with development teams, business areas, and international stakeholders in agile environments. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <style type=

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Business Analyst - Market Data Warsaw | 80-100% | Reference 7666  Are you ready to work at SIX and join the world of Finance and IT? Do you enjoy breaking down problems, working with data, and learning how technology supports business outcomes? Apply as a Business Analyst to join our international, fun and dynamic team, where you will support analysis activities and grow your skills with guidance from experienced colleagues. What You Will Do
• support analysis activities for data initiatives (market data), assisting with requirements gathering and helping translate business needs into clear, structured documentation
• help maintain data mappings and transformation rules (normalization, enrichment, identifiers) under guidance, and contribute to keeping documentation accurate and up to date
• support the documentation of API and messaging-based integrations for real-time and batch delivery, learning key concepts and assisting with interface specifications
• contribute to acceptance criteria and support testing activities (e.g., test cases, data checks) for data pipelines and data products
• work with senior analysts and delivery teams as an interface to stakeholders, supporting backlog refinement, capturing actions, and helping clarify requirements in an agile, international environment What You Bring
• bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (or equivalent practical experience) and initial experience (up to 2 years) in a Business Analyst, data, technology, or operations role preferably in Financial Services
• basic understanding of real-time and batch data delivery concepts, with interest in API/data integration patterns (e.g., REST, message buses) and willingness to learn on the job
• interest in market data and financial instruments/identifiers, and an understanding of the data lifecycle (ingest, normalize, store, distribute); able to support impact assessments for supplier or source changes
• ability to validate and analyze data, with confidence working with spreadsheets and large datasets; SQL or similar querying skills are an advantage
• familiarity with requirements/specification techniques (e.g., user stories, use cases) and attention to detail when documenting mappings and transformation rules
• comfortable working in an agile environment and using common BA tools and methods, with strong communication skills and the ability to ask the right questions; fluency in English (French is a plus) If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <scr

SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Business Analyst - Funds (with French) Warsaw | 80-100% | Reference 7631 Would you like to dive into the fascinating world of funds? Join our funds content team focusing on delivering precise and curated information to Asset Managers in France and Europe. You will specify and deliver high quality information on NAVs, fees and tax attributes, distributions, and fund classifications. Working closely with product, engineering, QA, and operations, you’ll translate changes from fund asset managers and markets into clear, testable requirements that ensure accurate and timely data for our French and Global clients. What You Will Do
• Gather, analyze, and document fund-specific operational needs and data requirements (detailed characteristics, net asset value, fees, dividends, taxation, categories, etc.).
• Define data mappings and validation rules from source providers to standardized schemas; maintain data dictionaries and business rules.
• Maintain fund categories and sector classifications; ensure consistent linkages to issuers and related reference data used by downstream analytics.
• Support data delivery via files, APIs, and cloud channels; define acceptance criteria; run/coordinate UAT and regression testing; monitor KPIs and triage incidents.
• Contribute to taxonomy and naming standardization; collaborate on process improvements that enhance completeness, accuracy, and timeliness. What You Bring
• 2–5 years of business analysis experience in financial information (funds/pricing preferred).
• Solid understanding of funds, NAV rules, distributions, and investor facing fee/tax attributes.
• Familiarity with fund data intake, validation, and dissemination workflows.
• Experience with data modeling, instrument identifiers (e.g., ISIN), and classification for funds/sectors.
• Ability to translate business needs into clear specifications and test cases (acceptance criteria).
• Proficiency with SQL and Excel; comfortable partnering with product managers, engineers, QA, and operations in a global setup. Strong
• documentation skills.Understanding of databases (Relational, Data River, Data Lakes…)
• Exposure to agile delivery, documentation standards, and testing methodologies.
• Keen learner and avid enthusiast. Fluent English (B2/C1) & French (B2) are mandatory. Comfortable communicating in a global, cross functional environment. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <div dir="auto" style="display:none " class="youtube874ff6b9255af776HEdBC-IF94s rtltextaligneligible row

Senior IT Audit & Risk Officer Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7824 Are you passionate about finance and modern technology? Do you have good organizational skills? If yes, this is the right place for you. As a member of our central team, you will coordinate and contribute to IT audits and assessments, ensuring their successful completion and timely delivery. Your support and guidance will help operational subject matter experts prepare evidence and navigate the audit lifecycle for both internal and external audits. You will actively engage with auditors and internal stakeholders, participating in audit discussions, risk assessments, and remediation activities. Additionally, you will coordinate ISAE/SOC-related attestation efforts and play a role in enhancing organizational reliance on these reports. What You Will Do
• As a member of our central team, you will coordinate and contribute to IT audits and assessments, ensuring their successful completion and timely delivery.
• Your support and guidance will help operational subject matter experts prepare evidence and navigate the audit lifecycle for both internal and external audits.
• You will actively engage with auditors and internal stakeholders, participating in audit discussions, risk assessments, and remediation activities.
• Additionally, you will coordinate ISAE/SOC-related attestation efforts and play a role in enhancing organizational reliance on these reports.
• Coordinate multiple IT audits and assessments simultaneously, working closely with operational teams from planning through execution to reporting. What You Bring
• Several years of experience in IT audit, risk, and control management; IT infrastructure and operations expertise is highly beneficial.
• Interdisciplinary knowledge of IT processes, infrastructure, and architectures.
• Ability to understand and apply risk, audit, and control methodologies within IT environments.
• Strong organizational skills, a structured approach to work, and the ability to systematically identify and resolve problems.
• Excellent written and spoken English communication skills; proficiency in German and/or Spanish is an advantage. Backend Java Developer Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7838 You want to code? You want to code for one of the most technologically advanced and innovative and stable stock exchanges? Are you ready to work at SIX? We need your engineering skills and passion for designing and implementing new features with great user experience. In your position you will be a part of the Trading Application Development team contributing and driving back-end development of our products. Your main duties as a Software Engineer, working as a Java Developer, will be the following What You Will Do
• exert your excellent Java developing skills with focus on back-end development in the area of primary market trading and trading GUI for the secondary market
• responsible to keep the application compliant to internal and external regulations
• translate user expectations and business requirements into state of the art solution designs following best practice in Java development
• work closely in an interdisciplinary team of developers, testers, product owners and business stakeholders in an agile environment (SCRUM and SAFe) What You Bring
• 5 years of professional hands-on experience in software engineering, with focus on multi-threaded applications development in Java (Java 8+, SpringBoot, WildFly, SOAP and REST services).
• A backpack of experience that includes excellent database knowledge with SQL and Hibernate.
• Excellent knowledge of object-oriented design, event-based message systems, and database design and development and may be also about FIX protocol or financial markets and their infrastructure.
• A positive and result-driven attitude with a high sense for quality, systematic thinking and a problem-solving mindset.

SIX Group is seeking a high performing Sales & Business Development professional to drive revenue growth across our fixed income data products in the UK and European markets. This role is focused on new business acquisition, commercial opportunity creation, and expansion of SIX’s footprint across bond market participants. This is a front office, client facing role for an individual who thrives in fast moving markets, enjoys building pipeline from the ground up, and can translate market structure and trading workflows into clear commercial value. • originate, develop, and close new revenue opportunities for fixed income data solutions across UK and European markets

• drive revenue growth through proactive outreach, face to face client meetings, and solution led consultative selling
• translate trading workflows, execution models, and market structure into clear, compelling commercial use cases
• partner with product and commercial teams to align client demand, feedback, and opportunities with product development What You Bring
• proven experience in fixed income data sales or business development with strong knowledge of bond markets and clients
• demonstrated success in new business generation, including pipeline creation and winning new institutional logos
• solid understanding of fixed income execution models and venue dynamics, including RFQ and CLOB market structures
• strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills with confidence engaging traders and senior stakeholders
• fluent English required for daily client engagement and internal collaboration across international teams If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 . descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Specialist HR Service Center (80-100%)

Zurich |  up to 40% Home Office | Reference 7951

For our dedicated Employee Lifecycle Team, we are looking for an experienced person as a Specialist HR Service Center (m/f) who will provide administrative support for the HR lifecycle from entry to exit for our line managers and employees. As part of our People Vision at SIX, we aim to continuously motivate and inspire our employees. In an exciting environment at the intersection of technology and finance within a dynamic and innovative company, SIX offers you diverse opportunities to fully contribute and develop your potential. We are a collaborative and dynamic team with a strong team spirit, shaping a culture-changing future at SIX together with the business.

The position is temporary until December 2027.

What You Will Do

• First-level support for all line managers and employees on administrative HR topics from entry to exit, as well as general labour law questions, including information on processes, time recording, absences, and fringe benefits

• Independent, accurate, and timely handling of entries, exits, and personnel changes, as well as preparation of contracts, confirmations, and employment references

• Independent updating and maintenance of personnel master data in SuccessFactors

• Responsibility for selected HR specialist topics (e.g. work permits, labour law, digitalisation, fringe benefits)

• Advising employees and line managers on all HR-related matters

What You Bring

• Commercial basic education and a higher professional qualification (e.g. HR specialist certificate)

• At least 3 years of professional experience in a similar environment

• You are passionate about administrative tasks, can think “outside the box,” enjoy proactively contributing to optimisations, and are happy to take responsibility for their implementation

• Very good user knowledge of MS Office programmes, technical affinity, SAP and/or SuccessFactors is an advantage

• Very good German and English skills, both written and spoken

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Maria Teresa Buchanan  at +41 58 399 8083 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
